//! Dental invoice (Liquidation) in the structure of **Anlage 2 GOZ**.
//!
//! Columns: Datum | Region/Zahn | Nr. | Leistungsbeschreibung | Anz. | Faktor | Betrag.
//! The practice currency is printed after each amount, not in the column title.
//! grouped into GOZ fees, GOÄ fees, § 9 expenses (material, external lab),
//! each with a subtotal; then net/VAT per rate (UStG § 14 Abs. 4 Nr. 7–8)
//! and the amount due. The document language is always German.
//!
//! The model is (de)serialisable so the issued invoice can be stored
//! verbatim in `issued_document.payload_json` and re-rendered later.

use serde::{Deserialize, Deserializer, Serialize};

/// `null` in the UI payload means "not set". `#[serde(default)]` only covers
/// a missing key, so an explicit null on a string or enum fails the command
/// with `invalid type: null, expected a string`.
fn null_as_default<'de, D, T>(deserializer: D) -> Result<T, D::Error>
where
    D: Deserializer<'de>,
    T: Deserialize<'de> + Default,
{
    Ok(Option::<T>::deserialize(deserializer)?.unwrap_or_default())
}

use super::core::{
    emit_pdf_document, format_date_dmy, format_eur, PageBuilder, PdfDocMeta, M_BOTTOM, M_LEFT,
    M_RIGHT,
};
use super::goz::{compute_totals, FACTOR_JUSTIFICATION_THRESHOLD};
use super::letterhead::{emit_letterhead, Letterhead, MetaRow};
use super::logo::PdfLogo;
use super::metrics::wrap_to_width;
use crate::error::AppError;

/// Which fee schedule / expense group a line belongs to.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum FeeSchedule {
    #[default]
    Goz,
    Goae,
    /// § 9 GOZ — practice material.
    Material,
    /// § 9 GOZ — external laboratory.
    Lab,
    /// Other non-fee items (e.g. Wegegeld § 8).
    Other,
}

impl FeeSchedule {
    pub fn is_fee(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, FeeSchedule::Goz | FeeSchedule::Goae)
    }

    fn heading(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            FeeSchedule::Goz => "Honorar nach GOZ",
            FeeSchedule::Goae => "Honorar nach GOÄ",
            FeeSchedule::Material => "Auslagen nach § 9 GOZ – Material",
            FeeSchedule::Lab => "Auslagen nach § 9 GOZ – Fremdlabor",
            FeeSchedule::Other => "Sonstige Positionen",
        }
    }

    const ORDER: [FeeSchedule; 5] = [
        FeeSchedule::Goz,
        FeeSchedule::Goae,
        FeeSchedule::Material,
        FeeSchedule::Lab,
        FeeSchedule::Other,
    ];
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum InvoiceKind {
    #[default]
    Invoice,
    /// Stornorechnung — negative amounts, references the original number.
    Cancellation,
}

/// One invoice line.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct InvoiceLine {
    /// Service description (understandable wording, § 10 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 GOZ).
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub description: String,
    /// Line amount in cents (unit fee × quantity, net).
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub amount_cents: i64,
    /// Fee number ("0010", "2197", GOÄ "Ä1").
    pub goz_nr: Option<String>,
    /// Increase factor.
    pub factor: Option<f64>,
    /// Unit price in cents (informational).
    pub unit_price_cents: Option<i64>,
    pub quantity: Option<i32>,
    /// Tooth / region (FDI).
    pub tooth_nr: Option<String>,
    /// ISO date of the service.
    pub treatment_date: Option<String>,
    /// VAT rate in percent (0 = exempt).
    pub vat_percent: Option<f64>,
    /// Kind of material (shown as sub-line).
    pub material: Option<String>,
    /// Justification for factor > 2.3 (§ 10 Abs. 3 GOZ).
    pub diagnosis_reason: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub fee_schedule: FeeSchedule,
    /// Points of the fee number — used to recompute the amount.
    pub points: Option<u32>,
    /// Analog billing (§ 6 Abs. 1 GOZ): number of the service the fee is
    /// taken from. `goz_nr` then holds the analog number.
    pub analog_of: Option<String>,
    /// Reference to an agreement under § 2 Abs. 1 und 2 GOZ (factor > 3.5).
    pub agreement_ref: Option<String>,
    /// Receipt for expenses above 25,56 EUR is attached.
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub receipt_attached: bool,
    /// Billed record (`treatment:<id>` / `examination:<id>`). Used to prevent
    /// billing the same service twice and to match payments to the invoice.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub source_ref: Option<String>,
}

impl InvoiceLine {
    /// Construct a minimal line (all GOZ fields empty).
    pub fn simple(description: impl Into<String>, amount_cents: i64) -> Self {
        Self {
            description: description.into(),
            amount_cents,
            fee_schedule: FeeSchedule::Other,
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }
}

/// Complete invoice (UStG § 14 Abs. 4 + GOZ § 10).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct Invoice {
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub kind: InvoiceKind,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub number: String,
    /// ISO issue date.
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub date: String,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub recipient_name: String,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub recipient_address: Vec<String>,
    /// Treated person (may differ from the recipient, e.g. a child).
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub patient_name: String,
    /// ISO date of birth of the treated person.
    pub patient_birth_date: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub practice_name: String,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub practice_address: Vec<String>,
    /// Full letterhead (name, address, contact, BSNR/ZANR), filled by the
    /// server. When empty, it is built from name + address + ids.
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub practice_lines: Vec<String>,
    /// DIN footer (identity, chamber, tax no., bank), filled by the server.
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub footer_lines: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub lines: Vec<InvoiceLine>,
    pub note: Option<String>,
    pub clinician_name: Option<String>,
    pub clinician_zanr: Option<String>,
    pub practice_bsnr: Option<String>,
    /// Steuernummer.
    pub tax_number: Option<String>,
    /// USt-IdNr.
    pub vat_id: Option<String>,
    pub bank_details: Option<Vec<String>>,
    pub payment_terms_text: Option<String>,
    /// Exemption notice, e.g. "Umsatzsteuerfrei gem. § 4 Nr. 14 UStG".
    pub vat_notice: Option<String>,
    /// ISO due date (invoice date + payment term), filled by the server.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub due_date: Option<String>,
    /// Original invoice number (cancellations).
    pub cancels_number: Option<String>,
    /// Original invoice date (cancellations).
    pub cancels_date: Option<String>,
    /// "ENTWURF" (preview) / "KOPIE" (reprint) — never stored.
    #[serde(skip)]
    pub watermark: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip)]
    pub logo: Option<PdfLogo>,
    /// Kept for API compatibility; GOZ invoices are always German.
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub locale: String,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
    pub rtl: bool,
}

impl Invoice {
    /// Gross total (net + VAT) in cents.
    pub fn total_cents(&self) -> i64 {
        compute_totals(self).gross
    }

    fn service_period(&self) -> Option<String> {
        let mut dates: Vec<&str> = self
            .lines
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|l| l.treatment_date.as_deref())
            .filter(|d| d.len() >= 10)
            .map(|d| &d[..10])
            .collect();
        dates.sort_unstable();
        let first = *dates.first()?;
        let last = *dates.last()?;
        Some(if first == last {
            format_date_dmy(first)
        } else {
            format!("{} – {}", format_date_dmy(first), format_date_dmy(last))
        })
    }
}

/// "12,94 EUR" (German decimal comma, thousands dot, practice currency).
pub fn fmt_amount(cents: i64) -> String {
    format_eur(cents)
}

fn fmt_factor(f: f64) -> String {
    let s = if ((f * 100.0).round() as i64) % 10 == 0 {
        format!("{f:.1}")
    } else {
        format!("{f:.2}")
    };
    s.replace('.', ",")
}

// Column layout relative to M_LEFT (content width 467 pt).
const X_DATE: i32 = M_LEFT;
const X_REGION: i32 = M_LEFT + 54;
const X_NR: i32 = M_LEFT + 88;
const X_DESC: i32 = M_LEFT + 130;
const DESC_W: i32 = 186;
const X_QTY_R: i32 = M_LEFT + 346;
const X_FACTOR_R: i32 = M_LEFT + 390;
const X_AMOUNT_R: i32 = M_RIGHT;
const ROW_FS: i32 = 8;
const ROW_STEP: i32 = 10;

fn emit_table_header(pb: &mut PageBuilder) {
    pb.table_header_band(M_LEFT, pb.y + 2, M_RIGHT - M_LEFT);
    pb.text(X_DATE + 2, 8, true, "Datum");
    pb.text(X_REGION, 8, true, "Region");
    pb.text(X_NR, 8, true, "Nr.");
    pb.text(X_DESC, 8, true, "Leistungsbeschreibung");
    pb.text_right(X_QTY_R, 8, true, "Anz.");
    pb.text_right(X_FACTOR_R, 8, true, "Faktor");
    pb.text_right(X_AMOUNT_R - 2, 8, true, "Betrag");
    pb.advance(10);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(11);
}

/// All text lines of the description column for one invoice line.
fn description_lines(line: &InvoiceLine) -> Vec<(String, bool)> {
    let w = f64::from(DESC_W);
    let mut out: Vec<(String, bool)> = wrap_to_width(&line.description, ROW_FS, false, w)
        .into_iter()
        .map(|s| (s, false))
        .collect();
    let mut sub = |text: String| {
        for s in wrap_to_width(&text, 7, false, w) {
            out.push((s, true));
        }
    };
    if let Some(orig) = line.analog_of.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        sub(format!("entsprechend Nr. {orig} gem. § 6 Abs. 1 GOZ"));
    }
    if let Some(m) = line.material.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        sub(format!("Art der Auslage: {m}"));
    }
    if line.receipt_attached {
        sub("Beleg liegt bei.".into());
    }
    if let Some(reason) = line
        .diagnosis_reason
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        let label = if line.factor.unwrap_or(0.0) > FACTOR_JUSTIFICATION_THRESHOLD {
            "Begründung (§ 10 Abs. 3 GOZ)"
        } else {
            "Hinweis"
        };
        sub(format!("{label}: {reason}"));
    }
    if let Some(a) = line
        .agreement_ref
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        sub(format!("Vereinbarung gem. § 2 Abs. 1 und 2 GOZ: {a}"));
    }
    out
}

fn emit_line(pb: &mut PageBuilder, line: &InvoiceLine) {
    let desc = description_lines(line);
    let height = desc.len() as i32 * ROW_STEP + 4;
    // Whole row must fit — otherwise new page with repeated header.
    if pb.y - height < M_BOTTOM + 6 {
        pb.break_page();
        emit_table_header(pb);
    }
    let top = pb.y;
    let date = line
        .treatment_date
        .as_deref()
        .map(format_date_dmy)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    pb.text(X_DATE + 2, ROW_FS, false, &date);
    pb.text(
        X_REGION,
        ROW_FS,
        false,
        line.tooth_nr.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
    );
    let nr = match (&line.goz_nr, line.analog_of.is_some()) {
        (Some(n), true) => format!("{n}a"),
        (Some(n), false) => n.clone(),
        (None, _) => String::new(),
    };
    pb.text(X_NR, ROW_FS, false, &nr);
    if line.fee_schedule.is_fee() {
        pb.text_right(
            X_QTY_R,
            ROW_FS,
            false,
            &line.quantity.unwrap_or(1).to_string(),
        );
        if let Some(f) = line.factor {
            pb.text_right(X_FACTOR_R, ROW_FS, false, &fmt_factor(f));
        }
    }
    pb.text_right(
        X_AMOUNT_R - 2,
        ROW_FS,
        false,
        &fmt_amount(line.amount_cents),
    );
    for (i, (text, small)) in desc.iter().enumerate() {
        pb.y = top - i as i32 * ROW_STEP;
        pb.text(X_DESC, if *small { 7 } else { ROW_FS }, false, text);
    }
    pb.y = top - height;
}

fn emit_sum_row(pb: &mut PageBuilder, label: &str, cents: i64, bold: bool, rule: bool) {
    pb.ensure_space(20);
    if rule {
        pb.hline(M_LEFT + 250, M_RIGHT);
        pb.advance(11);
    }
    pb.text_right(X_FACTOR_R, 9, bold, label);
    pb.text_right(X_AMOUNT_R - 2, 9, bold, &fmt_amount(cents));
    pb.advance(13);
}

/// Render an invoice (or cancellation invoice). Call [`super::goz::validate_invoice`]
/// first — the issuing service does this before allocating the number.
pub fn render_goz_invoice(inv: &Invoice) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let cancellation = inv.kind == InvoiceKind::Cancellation;
    let totals = compute_totals(inv);
    let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
    pb.watermark = inv.watermark.clone();

    // ---- Letterhead -------------------------------------------------------
    let mut practice = if inv.practice_lines.is_empty() {
        vec![inv.practice_name.clone()]
    } else {
        inv.practice_lines.clone()
    };
    if inv.practice_lines.is_empty() {
        practice.extend(inv.practice_address.iter().cloned());
        for id in [
            inv.practice_bsnr.as_deref().map(|b| format!("BSNR {b}")),
            inv.clinician_zanr.as_deref().map(|z| format!("ZANR {z}")),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter(|s| s.len() > 5)
        {
            practice.push(id);
        }
    }

    let mut meta = vec![
        MetaRow::new(
            if cancellation {
                "Storno-Nr."
            } else {
                "Rechnungs-Nr."
            },
            &inv.number,
        ),
        MetaRow::new("Rechnungsdatum", format_date_dmy(&inv.date)),
    ];
    if !cancellation {
        if let Some(d) = inv.due_date.as_deref().filter(|d| !d.trim().is_empty()) {
            meta.push(MetaRow::new("Zahlbar bis", format_date_dmy(d)));
        }
    }
    if let Some(p) = inv.service_period() {
        meta.push(MetaRow::new("Leistungszeitraum", p));
    }
    if !inv.patient_name.trim().is_empty() {
        let dob = inv
            .patient_birth_date
            .as_deref()
            .map(|d| format!(", geb. {}", format_date_dmy(d)))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        meta.push(MetaRow::new(
            "Behandelte Person",
            format!("{}{dob}", inv.patient_name),
        ));
    }
    if let Some(c) = inv
        .clinician_name
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        meta.push(MetaRow::new("Behandler/in", c));
    }

    let mut recipient = vec![inv.recipient_name.clone()];
    recipient.extend(inv.recipient_address.iter().cloned());

    let lh = Letterhead {
        practice_lines: &practice,
        meta_rows: &meta,
        address_lines: &recipient,
        show_sender_hint: true,
        logo: inv.logo.as_ref(),
        rtl: false,
        locale: "de",
        ..Default::default()
    };
    emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);

    // DIN footer: identity, tax, bank on every page.
    let mut footer = if !inv.footer_lines.is_empty() {
        inv.footer_lines.clone()
    } else {
        Vec::new()
    };
    if footer.is_empty() {
        footer.push(format!(
            "{} · {}",
            inv.practice_name,
            inv.practice_address.join(", ")
        ));
        let tax: Vec<String> = [
            inv.tax_number.as_deref().map(|t| format!("Steuer-Nr. {t}")),
            inv.vat_id.as_deref().map(|v| format!("USt-IdNr. {v}")),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .collect();
        if !tax.is_empty() {
            footer.push(tax.join(" · "));
        }
        if let Some(bank) = inv.bank_details.as_ref().filter(|b| !b.is_empty()) {
            footer.push(bank.join(" · "));
        }
    }
    pb.footer_lines.extend(footer);

    let title = if cancellation {
        "Stornorechnung"
    } else {
        "Rechnung"
    };
    pb.set_continuation(&inv.practice_name, &format!("{title} {}", inv.number), "de");

    // ---- Title --------------------------------------------------------------
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 16, true, title);
    pb.advance(18);
    let has_goz = inv.lines.iter().any(|l| l.fee_schedule == FeeSchedule::Goz);
    let has_goae = inv
        .lines
        .iter()
        .any(|l| l.fee_schedule == FeeSchedule::Goae);
    let basis = match (has_goz, has_goae) {
        (true, true) => "Liquidation nach GOZ und GOÄ",
        (true, false) => "Liquidation nach der Gebührenordnung für Zahnärzte (GOZ)",
        (false, true) => "Liquidation nach der Gebührenordnung für Ärzte (GOÄ)",
        _ => "",
    };
    if !basis.is_empty() {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, basis);
        pb.advance(14);
    }
    if cancellation {
        let orig = inv.cancels_number.as_deref().unwrap_or("-");
        let date = inv
            .cancels_date
            .as_deref()
            .map(|d| format!(" vom {}", format_date_dmy(d)))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        pb.wrapped(
            M_LEFT,
            9,
            false,
            &format!("Diese Stornorechnung hebt die Rechnung Nr. {orig}{date} vollständig auf."),
            M_RIGHT - M_LEFT,
        );
    }
    pb.advance(4);

    // ---- Table, grouped by schedule ---------------------------------------
    emit_table_header(&mut pb);
    for schedule in FeeSchedule::ORDER {
        let lines: Vec<&InvoiceLine> = inv
            .lines
            .iter()
            .filter(|l| l.fee_schedule == schedule)
            .collect();
        if lines.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        pb.ensure_space(30);
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, true, schedule.heading());
        pb.advance(11);
        let mut sum = 0;
        for l in lines {
            emit_line(&mut pb, l);
            sum += l.amount_cents;
        }
        emit_sum_row(
            &mut pb,
            &format!("Zwischensumme {}", short_label(schedule)),
            sum,
            false,
            true,
        );
        pb.advance(4);
    }

    // ---- Totals --------------------------------------------------------------
    pb.ensure_space(70);
    pb.advance(4);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT + 250, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(3);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT + 250, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(13);
    let total_label = if cancellation {
        "Stornobetrag"
    } else {
        "Rechnungsbetrag"
    };
    if totals.vat_groups.is_empty() {
        emit_sum_row(&mut pb, total_label, totals.gross, true, false);
    } else {
        emit_sum_row(&mut pb, "Nettobetrag", totals.net, false, false);
        for (rate, net, tax) in &totals.vat_groups {
            let rate_s = fmt_factor(*rate as f64 / 100.0)
                .trim_end_matches(",0")
                .to_string();
            emit_sum_row(
                &mut pb,
                &format!("zzgl. {rate_s} % USt auf {}", fmt_amount(*net)),
                *tax,
                false,
                false,
            );
        }
        emit_sum_row(&mut pb, total_label, totals.gross, true, true);
    }

    // ---- Notices -------------------------------------------------------------
    pb.advance(6);
    let width = M_RIGHT - M_LEFT;
    let exempt_part = inv
        .lines
        .iter()
        .any(|l| l.vat_percent.unwrap_or(0.0) <= 0.0);
    if exempt_part {
        if let Some(n) = inv.vat_notice.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
            let text = if totals.vat_groups.is_empty() {
                n.to_string()
            } else {
                format!("Positionen ohne USt-Ausweis: {n}")
            };
            pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, false, &text, width);
        }
    }
    if !cancellation {
        if let Some(t) = inv
            .payment_terms_text
            .as_deref()
            .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
        {
            pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, false, t, width);
        }
        // § 286 Abs. 3 S. 1 Hs. 2 BGB: a consumer only falls into default
        // 30 days after receipt if the invoice says so.
        pb.wrapped(
            M_LEFT,
            9,
            false,
            "Hinweis gem. § 286 Abs. 3 BGB: Sie kommen spätestens in Verzug, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Fälligkeit und Zugang dieser Rechnung leisten.",
            width,
        );
        // Payment details in the body, not only in the footer, so the
        // patient can transfer without searching the small print.
        if let Some(bank) = inv.bank_details.as_ref().filter(|b| !b.is_empty()) {
            pb.advance(4);
            pb.wrapped(
                M_LEFT,
                9,
                false,
                &format!(
                    "Bitte überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer {} auf folgendes Konto:",
                    inv.number
                ),
                width,
            );
            // Holder + bank on one line, IBAN + BIC on the next.
            let (head, tail): (Vec<&String>, Vec<&String>) = bank
                .iter()
                .partition(|l| !l.starts_with("IBAN") && !l.starts_with("BIC"));
            for part in [head, tail] {
                if !part.is_empty() {
                    let line: Vec<&str> = part.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
                    pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, true, &line.join(" · "), width);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(n) = inv.note.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        pb.advance(4);
        pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, false, n, width);
    }

    let pages = pb.finish();
    let images: Vec<PdfLogo> = inv.logo.clone().into_iter().collect();
    emit_pdf_document(
        &pages,
        &PdfDocMeta {
            title: format!("{title} {}", inv.number),
            subject: Some(inv.number.clone()),
            author: Some(inv.practice_name.clone()),
            locale: "de".into(),
        },
        &images,
    )
}

fn short_label(s: FeeSchedule) -> &'static str {
    match s {
        FeeSchedule::Goz => "GOZ",
        FeeSchedule::Goae => "GOÄ",
        FeeSchedule::Material => "Material",
        FeeSchedule::Lab => "Fremdlabor",
        FeeSchedule::Other => "Sonstiges",
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::super::goz::{unit_fee_cents, validate_invoice};
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn null_strings_from_the_ui_deserialize_as_empty() {
        let raw = r#"{
            "number": null,
            "date": "2026-11-10",
            "recipient_name": "Ada",
            "recipient_address": null,
            "practice_name": null,
            "practice_address": [],
            "patient_name": null,
            "locale": null,
            "rtl": null,
            "kind": null,
            "note": null,
            "lines": [{
                "description": null,
                "amount_cents": 1294,
                "fee_schedule": null,
                "tooth_nr": null,
                "treatment_date": null
            }]
        }"#;
        let inv: Invoice = serde_json::from_str(raw).expect("invoice json");
        assert_eq!(inv.number, "");
        assert_eq!(inv.locale, "");
        assert!(!inv.rtl);
        assert_eq!(inv.kind, InvoiceKind::Invoice);
        assert!(inv.note.is_none());
        assert_eq!(inv.lines.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(inv.lines[0].description, "");
        assert_eq!(inv.lines[0].fee_schedule, FeeSchedule::Goz);
        assert!(inv.lines[0].tooth_nr.is_none());
    }

    pub fn sample() -> Invoice {
        Invoice {
            number: "RE-2026-000001".into(),
            date: "2026-06-02".into(),
            recipient_name: "Max Muster".into(),
            recipient_address: vec!["Musterweg 1".into(), "10115 Berlin".into()],
            patient_name: "Lena Muster".into(),
            patient_birth_date: Some("2014-03-01".into()),
            practice_name: "Zahnarztpraxis Dr. Beispiel".into(),
            practice_address: vec!["Hauptstraße 2".into(), "10115 Berlin".into()],
            clinician_name: Some("Dr. Maria Beispiel".into()),
            practice_bsnr: Some("123456789".into()),
            clinician_zanr: Some("987654321".into()),
            tax_number: Some("12/345/67890".into()),
            bank_details: Some(vec![
                "IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00".into(),
                "BIC COBADEFFXXX".into(),
            ]),
            vat_notice: Some("Umsatzsteuerfrei gem. § 4 Nr. 14 UStG.".into()),
            payment_terms_text: Some("Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen ohne Abzug.".into()),
            lines: vec![
                InvoiceLine {
                    description: "Eingehende Untersuchung".into(),
                    goz_nr: Some("0010".into()),
                    points: Some(100),
                    factor: Some(2.3),
                    amount_cents: unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, 100, 2.3),
                    treatment_date: Some("2026-05-20".into()),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                InvoiceLine {
                    description: "Testposition Füllung, dreiflächig".into(),
                    goz_nr: Some("9999".into()),
                    points: Some(1_000),
                    factor: Some(3.0),
                    amount_cents: unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, 1_000, 3.0),
                    tooth_nr: Some("36".into()),
                    treatment_date: Some("2026-05-27".into()),
                    diagnosis_reason: Some(
                        "Erschwerte Trockenlegung bei subgingivaler Ausdehnung".into(),
                    ),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                InvoiceLine {
                    description: "Komposit-Material".into(),
                    fee_schedule: FeeSchedule::Material,
                    amount_cents: 3_200,
                    material: Some("Komposit, Charge 4711".into()),
                    receipt_attached: true,
                    treatment_date: Some("2026-05-27".into()),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            ],
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn valid_sample_passes_and_renders_german_form() {
        let inv = sample();
        validate_invoice(&inv).expect("valid");
        let pdf = render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&pdf);
        for needle in [
            "Rechnung",
            "Leistungsbeschreibung",
            "Zwischensumme GOZ",
            "Rechnungsbetrag",
            "Behandelte Person",
            "Steuer-Nr. 12/345/67890",
            "Begr\\374ndung",
            "Leistungszeitraum",
            "12,94 EUR",
        ] {
            assert!(s.contains(needle), "missing {needle}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_factor_above_2_3_without_reason_and_wrong_amount() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.lines[1].diagnosis_reason = None;
        inv.lines[0].amount_cents += 50;
        let err = validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(err.contains("error.invoice.line_factor_reason"));
        assert!(err.contains("error.invoice.line_amount_mismatch"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_missing_patient_dob_and_service_date() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.patient_birth_date = None;
        inv.lines[0].treatment_date = None;
        let err = validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(err.contains("error.invoice.patient_identity_missing"));
        assert!(err.contains("error.invoice.line_date"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn taxable_line_needs_tax_id_and_shows_vat() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.tax_number = None;
        inv.lines[2].vat_percent = Some(19.0);
        assert!(validate_invoice(&inv)
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("error.invoice.tax_id_missing"));
        inv.tax_number = Some("12/345/67890".into());
        validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap()).into_owned();
        assert!(s.contains("zzgl. 19 % USt"));
        assert_eq!(inv.total_cents(), compute_totals(&inv).net + 608);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cancellation_references_original() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.kind = InvoiceKind::Cancellation;
        inv.number = "ST-2026-000001".into();
        inv.cancels_number = Some("RE-2026-000001".into());
        for l in &mut inv.lines {
            l.amount_cents = -l.amount_cents;
        }
        validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap()).into_owned();
        assert!(s.contains("Stornorechnung"));
        assert!(s.contains("RE-2026-000001"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn long_invoice_repeats_header_on_every_page() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        let base = inv.lines[0].clone();
        inv.lines = (0..80).map(|_| base.clone()).collect();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap()).into_owned();
        let pages = s.matches("/Type /Page ").count();
        assert!(pages >= 3);
        assert_eq!(s.matches("(Leistungsbeschreibung)").count(), pages);
    }
}

//! DIN-5008-compliant letterhead for all MeDoc documents.
//!
//! Layout (Form A, window-envelope compatible):
//!
//! ```text
//! ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
//! │ Practice name (bold, 12 pt)               ┌───────────────────┐ │
//! │ Street                                    │ Meta block:       │ │
//! │ ZIP City                                  │ Invoice no.       │ │
//! │ Tel.                                      │ Date              │ │
//! │ Fax                                       │ Provider          │ │
//! │ E-Mail                                    │ Patient no.       │ │
//! │ Web                                       └───────────────────┘ │
//! │ BSNR                                                              │
//! │ ZANR                                                              │
//! │ ┌─── Practice / Street / ZIP City (7 pt, one line each) ───────┐ │
//! │ │                                                              │ │
//! │ │  Recipient address                                           │ │
//! │ │  (window envelope area, DIN 5008 A, Y 700–572)               │ │
//! │ │                                                              │ │
//! │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
//! │ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  │
//! │ [Content from Y ≈ 560]                                           │
//! └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
//! ```
//!
//! The letterhead is rendered **once** on the first page; on
//! continuation pages a short **header stub** (practice name + document no.)
//! is used (see [`emit_continuation_header`]).

use super::core::{
    pdf_locale, PageBuilder, ADDRESS_WINDOW_BOTTOM_Y, ADDRESS_WINDOW_Y, CONTENT_START_Y,
    INFO_BLOCK_TOP_Y, INFO_BLOCK_X, LETTERHEAD_MIN_Y, M_LEFT, M_RIGHT, M_TOP, SENDER_HINT_Y,
};
use super::logo::{LogoPlacement, PdfLogo, LOGO_GAP};

/// One row of the meta / information block: "label" + "value".
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MetaRow {
    pub label: String,
    pub value: String,
}

impl MetaRow {
    pub fn new(label: impl Into<String>, value: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.into(),
            value: value.into(),
        }
    }
}

/// Complete practice letterhead.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Letterhead<'a> {
    /// First line = practice name (bold); further lines = address, contact,
    /// one field per line in the saved order. A block taller than 45 mm
    /// grows the letterhead and moves the address down with it.
    pub practice_lines: &'a [String],
    /// Contact extras ("Tel: …"). Only used when `meta_rows` is empty.
    pub header_right_lines: &'a [String],
    /// Information block (invoice no., date, clinician, …).
    pub meta_rows: &'a [MetaRow],
    /// Recipient address in the window-envelope area.
    pub address_lines: &'a [String],
    /// Return address above the recipient. Lines already printed in the
    /// practice block are skipped, so the name and address appear once.
    pub show_sender_hint: bool,
    /// Place the address directly below the header (hand-out documents such
    /// as receipts). No fold marks in this mode.
    pub compact_address: bool,
    /// Practice logo from Settings (`practice.logo.v1`).
    pub logo: Option<&'a PdfLogo>,
    /// Arabic (or an explicit flag) mirrors the whole page, right to left.
    pub rtl: bool,
    /// Document language (`de` | `en` | `fr`; anything else → `de`).
    pub locale: &'a str,
}

/// Render the letterhead (DIN 5008 Form B) on the current page and place
/// `pb.y` below it. Returns the new `pb.y`.
///
/// Layout: practice block top-left. When it ends above 45 mm, the return
/// address, the window, and the information block stay on the DIN 5008
/// positions. A taller block keeps every field and moves the address down.
/// Without an address field the information block sits top-right.
pub fn emit_letterhead(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lh: &Letterhead) -> i32 {
    pb.locale = pdf_locale(lh.locale);
    if lh.rtl || pb.locale == "ar" {
        pb.rtl = true;
    }
    // One field per line. A payload that still joins "Tel. · email" or
    // "BSNR · ZANR" is split here so every document header matches.
    // Coordinates stay in the Latin layout. `PageBuilder` mirrors them when
    // `rtl` is set, so the logo and the information block are not swapped twice.
    // Each incoming line is one table row. A middle dot already joins the two
    // cells of that row, so it must not be split apart.
    let header_right_lines = split_header_fields(lh.header_right_lines);

    let mut text_left = M_LEFT;
    let mut text_right_cap = if lh.address_lines.is_empty() && !lh.meta_rows.is_empty() {
        INFO_BLOCK_X - 10
    } else {
        M_RIGHT
    };
    let mut left_y = M_TOP;
    if let Some(logo) = lh.logo {
        let x = logo.x_for_side(false);
        let y = logo.y_bottom(M_TOP);
        pb.draw_image(0, x, y, logo.display_w, logo.display_h);
        match logo.placement {
            LogoPlacement::Side => {
                text_left = logo.practice_text_left(false);
                text_right_cap = text_right_cap.min(logo.practice_text_right_cap(false));
            }
            LogoPlacement::Top => {
                left_y = y as i32 - LOGO_GAP;
            }
        }
    }
    let avail_pt = f64::from((text_right_cap - text_left).max(80));

    // --- 1. Practice block ----------------------------------------------------
    // One field per line, in the saved order. A block that still ends above
    // 45 mm keeps the DIN 5008 window. A taller block is printed in full and
    // the address moves down with it; nothing is sent to the footer.
    let rows = compose_letterhead(lh.practice_lines);
    let mut block_bottom = left_y - practice_block_span(&rows, avail_pt);
    if let Some(logo) = lh.logo.filter(|logo| logo.placement == LogoPlacement::Side) {
        block_bottom = block_bottom.min(logo.y_bottom(M_TOP) as i32 - 4);
    }
    let fits_window = block_bottom >= LETTERHEAD_MIN_Y;
    let window_layout = !lh.address_lines.is_empty() && !lh.compact_address && fits_window;
    left_y = emit_practice_rows(pb, &rows, text_left, left_y, avail_pt);
    if let Some(logo) = lh.logo.filter(|logo| logo.placement == LogoPlacement::Side) {
        left_y = left_y.min(logo.y_bottom(M_TOP) as i32 - 4);
    }

    // --- 2. Information block / contact -------------------------------------
    // Beside the name when there is no address window. A DIN window keeps the
    // block at its fixed position. A header that grew past 45 mm places it
    // under the practice lines, with the address.
    let info_beside_name = lh.address_lines.is_empty() || (lh.compact_address && fits_window);
    let mut right_y = M_TOP;
    let mut info_bottom = i32::MAX;
    if info_beside_name {
        if !lh.meta_rows.is_empty() {
            right_y = emit_info_block(pb, lh.meta_rows, INFO_BLOCK_X, M_TOP);
        } else {
            for line in header_right_lines.iter().take(8) {
                pb.y = right_y;
                pb.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, line);
                right_y -= 11;
            }
        }
    }
    let header_bottom = left_y.min(right_y);

    // --- 3. Address -----------------------------------------------------------
    let rule_y;
    if lh.address_lines.is_empty() {
        rule_y = header_bottom - 8;
    } else if window_layout {
        if !lh.meta_rows.is_empty() {
            info_bottom = emit_info_block(pb, lh.meta_rows, INFO_BLOCK_X, INFO_BLOCK_TOP_Y);
        } else {
            let mut y = M_TOP;
            for line in header_right_lines.iter().take(8) {
                pb.y = y;
                pb.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, line);
                y -= 11;
            }
        }
        pb.letter_marks = true;
        if lh.show_sender_hint {
            // Name, street, and city each on their own line (no middot).
            emit_sender_hint_lines(pb, lh.practice_lines, SENDER_HINT_Y, 8);
        }
        emit_address_lines(
            pb,
            lh.address_lines,
            ADDRESS_WINDOW_Y,
            ADDRESS_WINDOW_BOTTOM_Y,
        );
        rule_y = (CONTENT_START_Y + 12).min(info_bottom - 2);
    } else if lh.compact_address && fits_window {
        let mut addr_y = header_bottom - 16;
        if lh.show_sender_hint {
            addr_y = emit_sender_hint_lines(pb, lh.practice_lines, addr_y, 9);
        }
        addr_y = emit_address_lines(pb, lh.address_lines, addr_y, i32::MIN);
        rule_y = addr_y - 8;
    } else {
        let mut block_y = header_bottom - 16;
        if lh.show_sender_hint {
            block_y = emit_sender_hint_lines(pb, lh.practice_lines, block_y, 9);
        }
        let address_top = block_y;
        let addr_bottom = emit_address_lines(pb, lh.address_lines, address_top, i32::MIN);
        let info_end = if !lh.meta_rows.is_empty() {
            emit_info_block(pb, lh.meta_rows, INFO_BLOCK_X, address_top)
        } else {
            let mut y = address_top;
            for line in header_right_lines.iter().take(8) {
                pb.y = y;
                pb.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, line);
                y -= 11;
            }
            y
        };
        rule_y = addr_bottom.min(info_end) - 8;
    }

    pb.hline_gray(M_LEFT, rule_y, M_RIGHT, 0.72);
    pb.y = rule_y - 16;
    pb.y
}

fn emit_address_lines(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lines: &[String], start_y: i32, min_y: i32) -> i32 {
    let max_pt = super::core::MM * 80.0;
    let mut y = start_y;
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        let size = if i == 0 { 11 } else { 10 };
        for chunk in super::metrics::wrap_to_width(line, size, false, max_pt) {
            if y < min_y {
                // Address field is full (max ~6 lines per DIN 5008); keep the
                // remaining text on the last line instead of overprinting.
                break;
            }
            pb.y = y;
            pb.text(M_LEFT, size, false, &chunk);
            y -= if size == 11 { 13 } else { 12 };
        }
    }
    y
}

/// Short header for continuation pages.
///
/// [`PageBuilder::break_page`] now draws it automatically once registered,
/// so this only registers + draws on the first call and is a no-op afterwards.
pub fn emit_continuation_header(pb: &mut PageBuilder, practice_name: &str, doc_title: &str) {
    let locale = pb.locale;
    emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, locale);
}

pub fn emit_continuation_header_locale(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    practice_name: &str,
    doc_title: &str,
    _locale: &str,
) {
    if pb.continuation.is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let locale = pb.locale;
    pb.set_continuation(practice_name, doc_title, locale);
    let cont = super::i18n::t(locale, super::i18n::Phrase::Continued);
    pb.y = M_TOP;
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, practice_name);
    pb.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, &format!("{doc_title} ({cont})"));
    pb.y -= 4;
    let y = pb.y;
    pb.hline_at(M_LEFT, y, M_RIGHT);
    pb.y -= 16;
}

/// Information block: label (8 pt) and value (9 pt bold), right-aligned to the
/// page margin. `x` is only the left limit used for wrapping. Returns the
/// lowest `y` written.
fn emit_info_block(pb: &mut PageBuilder, rows: &[MetaRow], x: i32, start_y: i32) -> i32 {
    let right = if x <= M_LEFT + 8 {
        INFO_BLOCK_X - 12
    } else {
        M_RIGHT
    };
    let max_pt = f64::from((right - x).max(80));
    let mut y = start_y;
    for row in rows {
        pb.y = y;
        pb.text_right(right, 8, false, &row.label);
        y -= 10;
        for chunk in super::metrics::wrap_to_width(&row.value, 9, true, max_pt) {
            pb.y = y;
            pb.text_right(right, 9, true, &chunk);
            y -= 11;
        }
        y -= 3;
    }
    y
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum HeaderKind {
    Title,
    Body,
    Contact,
    Identity,
}

struct HeaderRow {
    text: String,
    kind: HeaderKind,
}

/// One incoming line is one table row. A middle dot stays in the line: it
/// separates the two cells of that row. An exact duplicate line is skipped.
fn compose_letterhead(lines: &[String]) -> Vec<HeaderRow> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for line in lines {
        let text = line.trim();
        if text.is_empty() || out.iter().any(|row: &HeaderRow| row.text == text) {
            continue;
        }
        let kind = if out.is_empty() {
            HeaderKind::Title
        } else {
            classify_header_line(text)
        };
        out.push(HeaderRow {
            text: text.to_string(),
            kind,
        });
    }
    out
}

fn header_row_style(kind: HeaderKind) -> (i32, i32, bool) {
    match kind {
        HeaderKind::Title => (13, 16, true),
        HeaderKind::Identity => (8, 11, false),
        HeaderKind::Contact | HeaderKind::Body => (9, 12, false),
    }
}

/// Vertical span of the practice block, in points, before it is drawn.
fn practice_block_span(rows: &[HeaderRow], avail_pt: f64) -> i32 {
    let mut span = 0;
    for row in rows {
        let (size, step, bold) = header_row_style(row.kind);
        let lines = super::metrics::wrap_to_width(&row.text, size, bold, avail_pt).len() as i32;
        span += step * lines;
    }
    span
}

fn emit_practice_rows(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    rows: &[HeaderRow],
    text_left: i32,
    start_y: i32,
    avail_pt: f64,
) -> i32 {
    let mut y = start_y;
    for row in rows {
        let (size, step, bold) = header_row_style(row.kind);
        for chunk in super::metrics::wrap_to_width(&row.text, size, bold, avail_pt) {
            pb.y = y;
            if row.kind == HeaderKind::Identity {
                pb.text_gray(text_left, size, bold, &chunk, 0.35);
            } else {
                pb.text(text_left, size, bold, &chunk);
            }
            y -= step;
        }
    }
    y
}

fn classify_header_line(line: &str) -> HeaderKind {
    let t = line.trim();
    let lower = t.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if lower.starts_with("tel")
        || lower.starts_with("fax")
        || lower.starts_with("email")
        || lower.starts_with("e-mail")
        || lower.starts_with("notdienst")
        || t.contains('@')
        || (t.contains('.') && !t.contains(' ') && !t.contains('@'))
    {
        return HeaderKind::Contact;
    }
    if lower.starts_with("bsnr")
        || lower.starts_with("zanr")
        || lower.starts_with("kv ")
        || lower.starts_with("steuer")
        || lower.starts_with("tax")
        || lower.starts_with("vat")
        || lower.starts_with("iban")
        || lower.starts_with("bic")
        || lower.starts_with("konto")
    {
        return HeaderKind::Identity;
    }
    HeaderKind::Body
}

/// Drop middots from a header line and keep each field on its own line.
/// A field that is already in the header is not added again.
fn split_header_fields(lines: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for line in lines {
        let parts: Vec<&str> = if line.contains('·') {
            line.split('·').collect()
        } else {
            vec![line.as_str()]
        };
        for part in parts {
            let t = part.trim();
            if t.is_empty() || out.iter().any(|existing| existing == t) {
                continue;
            }
            out.push(t.to_string());
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Return address above the recipient window. The practice block already
/// prints the name, street, and city, so those lines are not repeated.
fn sender_hint_lines(practice_lines: &[String]) -> Vec<&str> {
    let header: Vec<&str> = practice_lines
        .iter()
        .map(|s| s.trim())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .collect();
    practice_lines
        .iter()
        .map(|s| s.trim())
        .filter(|line| !line.is_empty() && !header.contains(line))
        .take(3)
        .collect()
}

fn emit_sender_hint_lines(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    practice_lines: &[String],
    start_y: i32,
    step: i32,
) -> i32 {
    let max = super::core::MM * 80.0;
    let mut y = start_y;
    for line in sender_hint_lines(practice_lines) {
        let fitted = super::metrics::wrap_to_width(line, 7, false, max)
            .into_iter()
            .next()
            .unwrap_or_default();
        if fitted.trim().is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        pb.y = y;
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 7, false, &fitted);
        y -= step;
    }
    y
}

/// Localised "(Praxisstempel)" label.
pub fn stamp_label(locale: &str) -> &'static str {
    super::i18n::t(locale, super::i18n::Phrase::Stamp)
}

/// Signature block: line, clinician name, title · ZANR · BSNR, stamp label.
pub fn emit_signature_block(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    clinician_name: Option<&str>,
    professional_title: Option<&str>,
    zanr: Option<&str>,
    bsnr: Option<&str>,
    show_stempel_label: bool,
) {
    pb.ensure_space(90);
    pb.advance(20);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(28);

    let y = pb.y;
    pb.hline_at(M_LEFT, y, M_LEFT + 180);
    pb.advance(14);

    if let Some(n) = clinician_name.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 10, true, n);
        pb.advance(12);
    }

    let mut subline = Vec::new();
    if let Some(b) = professional_title.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        subline.push(b.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(z) = zanr.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        subline.push(format!("ZANR: {z}"));
    }
    if let Some(b) = bsnr.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        subline.push(format!("BSNR: {b}"));
    }
    if !subline.is_empty() {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, &subline.join(" · "));
        pb.advance(11);
    }

    if show_stempel_label {
        pb.advance(6);
        let label = stamp_label(pb.locale);
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, false, label);
    }
}

/// Bank-details block (prefer [`footer_lines_for_practice`] → page footer).
pub fn emit_bank_details(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lines: &[String]) {
    let locale = pb.locale;
    emit_bank_details_locale(pb, lines, locale);
}

pub fn emit_bank_details_locale(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lines: &[String], locale: &str) {
    if lines.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let title = super::i18n::t(locale, super::i18n::Phrase::BankDetails);
    pb.ensure_space(40 + lines.len() as i32 * 11);
    pb.advance(6);
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, title);
    pb.advance(11);
    for line in lines {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, line);
        pb.advance(11);
    }
}

/// DIN 5008 footer content: legal identity, tax and bank details.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct PracticeFooter {
    pub practice_name: String,
    pub tax_number: Option<String>,
    pub vat_id: Option<String>,
    pub iban: Option<String>,
    pub bic: Option<String>,
    pub bank_name: Option<String>,
    pub chamber: Option<String>,
}

/// Build the (max. 3) footer lines for [`PageBuilder::footer_lines`].
pub fn footer_lines_for_practice(f: &PracticeFooter, locale: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut l1 = vec![f.practice_name.trim().to_string()];
    if let Some(c) = f.chamber.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l1.push(format!(
            "{}: {c}",
            super::i18n::t(locale, super::i18n::Phrase::Chamber)
        ));
    }
    let mut l2 = Vec::new();
    if let Some(t) = f.tax_number.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l2.push(format!(
            "{} {t}",
            super::i18n::t(locale, super::i18n::Phrase::TaxNo)
        ));
    }
    if let Some(v) = f.vat_id.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l2.push(format!(
            "{} {v}",
            super::i18n::t(locale, super::i18n::Phrase::VatId)
        ));
    }
    let mut l3 = Vec::new();
    if let Some(b) = f.bank_name.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l3.push(b.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(i) = f.iban.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l3.push(format!("IBAN {i}"));
    }
    if let Some(b) = f.bic.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l3.push(format!("BIC {b}"));
    }
    [l1, l2, l3]
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|v| v.iter().any(|s| !s.is_empty()))
        .map(|v| v.join(" · "))
        .collect()
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tests

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn dummy_practice() -> Vec<String> {
        vec![
            "Dental practice Dr. Sample".into(),
            "Hauptstraße 1".into(),
            "10115 Berlin".into(),
            "Tel: 030/123456".into(),
        ]
    }

    fn dummy_address() -> Vec<String> {
        vec![
            "Max Sample".into(),
            "Sample Street 2".into(),
            "10117 Berlin".into(),
        ]
    }

    #[test]
    fn header_prints_each_practice_line_once() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        let practice = vec![
            "MeDoc Demo Dental Practice".into(),
            "Am Markt 12".into(),
            "28195 Bremen".into(),
            "Tel. +49 421 555 0100 · BSNR 987654321".into(),
            "MeDoc Demo Dental Practice".into(),
            "BSNR 987654321".into(),
        ];
        let addr = dummy_address();
        let lh = Letterhead {
            practice_lines: &practice,
            address_lines: &addr,
            show_sender_hint: true,
            locale: "de",
            ..Default::default()
        };
        emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);
        let page = pb.finish().remove(0);
        assert_eq!(page.matches("(MeDoc Demo Dental Practice)").count(), 1);
        assert_eq!(page.matches("(Am Markt 12)").count(), 1);
        assert_eq!(page.matches("(28195 Bremen)").count(), 1);
        let tel = page.find("Tel. +49 421 555 0100").expect("phone");
        let near = &page[tel..(tel + 80).min(page.len())];
        assert!(
            near.contains("BSNR 987654321"),
            "phone and registration stay on one line"
        );
        assert_eq!(page.matches("(BSNR 987654321)").count(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn letterhead_renders_without_panic() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        let practice = dummy_practice();
        let addr = dummy_address();
        let meta = vec![
            MetaRow::new("Invoice-Nr.", "RE-2026-001"),
            MetaRow::new("Date", "19.04.2026"),
        ];
        let lh = Letterhead {
            practice_lines: &practice,
            meta_rows: &meta,
            address_lines: &addr,
            header_right_lines: &[],
            show_sender_hint: true,
            compact_address: false,
            logo: None,
            rtl: false,
            locale: "en",
        };
        let y_after = emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);
        assert!(y_after < M_TOP);
        assert!(pb.letter_marks, "a short header keeps the envelope marks");
        let pages = pb.finish();
        assert_eq!(pages.len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn header_info_block_aligns_to_the_right_margin() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        let practice = dummy_practice();
        let addr = dummy_address();

//! Practice logo (`practice.logo.v1`) → PDF Image XObject.
//!
//! Stored as `{"mime":"image/png"|"image/jpeg","data":"<base64>"}`.

use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, Engine as _};
use flate2::write::ZlibEncoder;
use flate2::Compression;
use image::{ImageReader, Rgba, RgbaImage};
use serde::Deserialize;
use std::io::{Cursor, Write};

use super::core::{M_LEFT, M_RIGHT};

/// Where the practice logo sits on the letterhead.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum LogoPlacement {
    /// Beside the practice name.
    #[default]
    Side,
    /// Above the practice name.
    Top,
}

impl LogoPlacement {
    pub fn parse(raw: &str) -> Self {
        match raw.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
            "top" => Self::Top,
            _ => Self::Side,
        }
    }
}

/// `showOnDocuments` in `practice.logo.v1`. Missing means the logo is printed.
pub fn logo_visible_on_documents(raw: &str) -> bool {
    serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(raw.trim())
        .ok()
        .and_then(|value| value.get("showOnDocuments").and_then(|flag| flag.as_bool()))
        .unwrap_or(true)
}

/// `placement` in `practice.logo.v1`. Missing or unknown means beside the name.
pub fn logo_placement(raw: &str) -> LogoPlacement {
    let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(raw.trim()) else {
        return LogoPlacement::default();
    };
    let Some(text) = value.get("placement").and_then(|flag| flag.as_str()) else {
        return LogoPlacement::default();
    };
    LogoPlacement::parse(text)
}

/// Max logo box on the letterhead (points).
pub const LOGO_MAX_HEIGHT: f64 = 48.0;
pub const LOGO_MAX_WIDTH: f64 = 120.0;
/// Gap between logo and practice text.
pub const LOGO_GAP: i32 = 10;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
struct LogoKv {
    /// Kept for Settings / KV compatibility; decode sniffs image bytes.
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    mime: String,
    data: String,
}

/// Decoded raster ready for a PDF Image XObject (DeviceRGB, FlateDecode).
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PdfLogo {
    pub width_px: u32,
    pub height_px: u32,
    /// Compressed RGB samples (zlib).
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub display_w: f64,
    pub display_h: f64,
    pub placement: LogoPlacement,
}

impl PdfLogo {
    /// Parse `practice.logo.v1` JSON. Returns `None` on missing/invalid data.
    pub fn from_kv_json(raw: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        let parsed: LogoKv = serde_json::from_str(raw.trim()).ok()?;
        // Prefer sniffing bytes over trusting `mime` — browsers often store WebP/GIF
        // while Settings preview still shows the image.
        let mut b64 = parsed.data.trim();
        if let Some((_, rest)) = b64.split_once("base64,") {
            b64 = rest.trim();
        }
        if !logo_visible_on_documents(raw) {
            return None;
        }
        let bytes = STANDARD.decode(b64).ok()?;
        if bytes.is_empty() || bytes.len() > 4_000_000 {
            return None;
        }
        let mut logo = Self::from_image_bytes(&bytes)?;
        logo.placement = logo_placement(raw);
        Some(logo)
    }

    pub fn from_image_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<Self> {
        let reader = ImageReader::new(Cursor::new(bytes))
            .with_guessed_format()
            .ok()?;
        let mut rgba = reader.decode().ok()?.to_rgba8();
        let (width_px, height_px) = rgba.dimensions();
        // Ignore 1×1 / placeholder “logos” (e.g. demo seed) — use classic letterhead.
        if width_px < 8 || height_px < 8 || width_px > 4096 || height_px > 4096 {
            return None;
        }
        // Drop transparency-grid / edge backdrop, then flatten onto white paper.
        strip_letterhead_backdrop(&mut rgba);
        let rgb = flatten_rgba_on_white(&rgba);
        let mut enc = ZlibEncoder::new(Vec::new(), Compression::fast());
        enc.write_all(rgb.as_raw()).ok()?;
        let data = enc.finish().ok()?;
        let (display_w, display_h) = fit_display(width_px, height_px);
        Some(Self {
            width_px,
            height_px,
            data,
            display_w,
            display_h,
            placement: LogoPlacement::Side,
        })
    }

    /// Bottom-left X of the logo box (top aligns with `M_TOP`).
    pub fn x_for_side(&self, rtl: bool) -> f64 {
        if rtl {
            f64::from(M_RIGHT) - self.display_w
        } else {
            f64::from(M_LEFT)
        }
    }

    /// Bottom Y of the logo (PDF coords; top of page is high Y).
    pub fn y_bottom(&self, top_y: i32) -> f64 {
        f64::from(top_y) - self.display_h
    }

    /// Left margin for practice text when logo is on the left (LTR).
    pub fn practice_text_left(&self, rtl: bool) -> i32 {
        if rtl {
            M_LEFT
        } else {
            M_LEFT + self.display_w.round() as i32 + LOGO_GAP
        }
    }

    /// Right bound for practice text. A side logo only narrows the block when
    /// it sits on the right (RTL). A top logo leaves the full text width.
    pub fn practice_text_right_cap(&self, rtl: bool) -> i32 {
        if self.placement == LogoPlacement::Side && rtl {
            M_RIGHT - self.display_w.round() as i32 - LOGO_GAP
        } else {
            M_RIGHT
        }
    }
}

fn fit_display(w: u32, h: u32) -> (f64, f64) {
    let w = f64::from(w.max(1));
    let h = f64::from(h.max(1));
    let scale = (LOGO_MAX_WIDTH / w).min(LOGO_MAX_HEIGHT / h).min(1.0);
    (w * scale, h * scale)
}

fn channel_close(a: u8, b: u8, tol: i32) -> bool {
    (i32::from(a) - i32::from(b)).abs() <= tol
}

fn rgba_close(a: Rgba<u8>, b: Rgba<u8>, tol: i32) -> bool {
    channel_close(a[0], b[0], tol)
        && channel_close(a[1], b[1], tol)
        && channel_close(a[2], b[2], tol)
}

/// Classic editor transparency grid + near-white paper crumbs.
///
/// macOS / modern previews often use ~`#EEEEEE` with white (not only `#C0C0C0`).
fn looks_like_backdrop(px: Rgba<u8>) -> bool {
    if px[3] < 24 {
        return true;
    }
    let (r, g, b) = (px[0], px[1], px[2]);
    // Low-chroma (neutral) and bright enough to be paper / transparency grid.
    let chroma_ok = channel_close(r, g, 18) && channel_close(g, b, 18);
    chroma_ok && r >= 200 && g >= 200 && b >= 200
}

/// Flood-fill from the image border through backdrop-like pixels and clear them
/// (alpha → 0). Removes exported transparency grids without eating gold/brand ink.
fn strip_letterhead_backdrop(img: &mut RgbaImage) {
    let (w, h) = img.dimensions();
    if w == 0 || h == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let mut visited = vec![false; (w * h) as usize];
    let mut stack: Vec<(u32, u32)> = Vec::new();

    let push = |stack: &mut Vec<(u32, u32)>, visited: &mut [bool], x: u32, y: u32| {
        let i = (y * w + x) as usize;
        if visited[i] {
            return;
        }
        visited[i] = true;
        stack.push((x, y));
    };

    for x in 0..w {
        push(&mut stack, &mut visited, x, 0);
        push(&mut stack, &mut visited, x, h - 1);
    }
    for y in 0..h {
        push(&mut stack, &mut visited, 0, y);
        push(&mut stack, &mut visited, w - 1, y);
    }

    while let Some((x, y)) = stack.pop() {
        let px = *img.get_pixel(x, y);
        if !looks_like_backdrop(px) {
            // Corner seed that is not backdrop (rare) — still allow flood only through backdrop.
            // If the edge pixel is brand color, do not clear it or expand.
            continue;
        }
        img.put_pixel(x, y, Rgba([255, 255, 255, 0]));
        for (nx, ny) in [
            (x.wrapping_sub(1), y),
            (x + 1, y),
            (x, y.wrapping_sub(1)),
            (x, y + 1),
        ] {
            if nx >= w || ny >= h {
                continue;
            }
            let i = (ny * w + nx) as usize;
            if visited[i] {
                continue;
            }
            let n = *img.get_pixel(nx, ny);
            if looks_like_backdrop(n) || rgba_close(n, px, 28) {
                push(&mut stack, &mut visited, nx, ny);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn flatten_rgba_on_white(img: &RgbaImage) -> image::RgbImage {
    let (w, h) = img.dimensions();
    let mut out = image::RgbImage::new(w, h);
    for (x, y, px) in img.enumerate_pixels() {
        let a = f32::from(px[3]) / 255.0;
        let r = (f32::from(px[0]) * a + 255.0 * (1.0 - a)).round() as u8;
        let g = (f32::from(px[1]) * a + 255.0 * (1.0 - a)).round() as u8;
        let b = (f32::from(px[2]) * a + 255.0 * (1.0 - a)).round() as u8;
        out.put_pixel(x, y, image::Rgb([r, g, b]));
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn decodes_tiny_png_kv() {
        // Real 16×16 PNG (not the 1×1 seed placeholder)
        let img = image::RgbImage::from_pixel(16, 16, image::Rgb([20, 80, 160]));
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        image::DynamicImage::ImageRgb8(img)
            .write_to(&mut std::io::Cursor::new(&mut buf), image::ImageFormat::Png)
            .expect("encode");
        use base64::Engine;
        let b64 = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&buf);
        let json = format!(r#"{{"mime":"image/png","data":"{b64}"}}"#);
        let logo = PdfLogo::from_kv_json(&json).expect("logo");
        assert_eq!(logo.width_px, 16);
        assert_eq!(logo.height_px, 16);
        assert_eq!(logo.placement, LogoPlacement::Side);
        let top_json = format!(
            r#"{{"mime":"image/png","data":"{b64}","placement":"top","showOnDocuments":true}}"#
        );
        assert_eq!(
            PdfLogo::from_kv_json(&top_json).expect("top").placement,
            LogoPlacement::Top
        );
        let hidden = format!(r#"{{"mime":"image/png","data":"{b64}","showOnDocuments":false}}"#);
        assert!(PdfLogo::from_kv_json(&hidden).is_none());
        assert!(logo.display_h <= LOGO_MAX_HEIGHT);
        assert!(logo.x_for_side(false) < logo.x_for_side(true));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_missing_flag_shows_the_logo_and_false_hides_it() {
        assert!(logo_visible_on_documents(
            r#"{"mime":"image/png","data":"aa"}"#
        ));
        assert!(!logo_visible_on_documents(
            r#"{"mime":"image/png","data":"aa","showOnDocuments":false}"#
        ));
        assert!(logo_visible_on_documents("not-json"));
        assert_eq!(logo_placement(r#"{"placement":"top"}"#), LogoPlacement::Top);
        assert_eq!(
            logo_placement(r#"{"placement":"side"}"#),
            LogoPlacement::Side
        );
        assert_eq!(logo_placement("{}"), LogoPlacement::Side);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_one_pixel_placeholder() {
        let json = r#"{"mime":"image/png","data":"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="}"#;
        assert!(PdfLogo::from_kv_json(json).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn accepts_data_url_prefixed_base64() {
        let img = image::RgbImage::from_pixel(12, 12, image::Rgb([200, 40, 40]));
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        image::DynamicImage::ImageRgb8(img)
            .write_to(&mut std::io::Cursor::new(&mut buf), image::ImageFormat::Png)
            .expect("encode");
        use base64::Engine;
        let b64 = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&buf);
        let json = format!(r#"{{"mime":"image/webp","data":"data:image/png;base64,{b64}"}}"#);
        let logo = PdfLogo::from_kv_json(&json).expect("logo despite mime/data-url");
        assert_eq!(logo.width_px, 12);
    }

    #[test]
    fn strips_checkerboard_backdrop_keeps_subject() {
        let mut img = RgbaImage::from_fn(32, 32, |x, y| {
            // Classic transparency grid.
            if ((x / 4) + (y / 4)) % 2 == 0 {
                Rgba([255, 255, 255, 255])
            } else {
                Rgba([204, 204, 204, 255])
            }
        });
        // Solid brand blob in the center.
        for y in 10..22 {
            for x in 10..22 {
                img.put_pixel(x, y, Rgba([180, 120, 40, 255]));
            }
        }
        strip_letterhead_backdrop(&mut img);
        let flat = flatten_rgba_on_white(&img);
        // Corner must be paper white after flatten.
        assert_eq!(*flat.get_pixel(0, 0), image::Rgb([255, 255, 255]));
        assert_eq!(*flat.get_pixel(31, 31), image::Rgb([255, 255, 255]));
        // Subject remains gold-ish.
        let mid = *flat.get_pixel(16, 16);
        assert!(mid[0] > 100 && mid[1] > 60 && mid[2] < 80, "{mid:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn strips_macos_light_gray_transparency_grid() {
        // Observed in production screenshots: white + ~#EEEEEE cells.
        let mut img = RgbaImage::from_fn(40, 40, |x, y| {
            if ((x / 5) + (y / 5)) % 2 == 0 {
                Rgba([255, 255, 255, 255])
            } else {
                Rgba([238, 238, 238, 255])
            }
        });
        for y in 12..28 {
            for x in 12..28 {
                img.put_pixel(x, y, Rgba([190, 130, 45, 255]));
            }
        }
        strip_letterhead_backdrop(&mut img);
        let flat = flatten_rgba_on_white(&img);
        assert_eq!(*flat.get_pixel(1, 1), image::Rgb([255, 255, 255]));
        assert_eq!(*flat.get_pixel(7, 7), image::Rgb([255, 255, 255]));
        let mid = *flat.get_pixel(20, 20);
        assert!(mid[0] > 150 && mid[2] < 80, "{mid:?}");
    }
}

//! Glyph widths for the two base-14 fonts MeDoc uses (Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold).
//!
//! Values are the advance widths from Adobe's Core14 AFM files (units of
//! 1/1000 em). Replaces the old `chars × 0.52 × size` guess, which made
//! right-aligned amounts and column wrapping drift.
//!
//! When the renderer moves to embedded fonts (PDF/A, Arabic), this module is
//! replaced by the font's own `hmtx` table.

/// Advance width of `ch` in 1/1000 em.
pub fn glyph_width(ch: char, bold: bool) -> u32 {
    let c = ch as u32;
    if (32..=126).contains(&c) {
        let idx = (c - 32) as usize;
        return if bold {
            BOLD_ASCII[idx]
        } else {
            REGULAR_ASCII[idx]
        } as u32;
    }
    // Accented letters share the width of their base letter in Helvetica.
    let base = match ch {
        'ä' | 'à' | 'á' | 'â' | 'å' => Some('a'),
        'Ä' | 'À' | 'Á' | 'Â' | 'Å' => Some('A'),
        'ö' | 'ò' | 'ó' | 'ô' | 'ø' => Some('o'),
        'Ö' | 'Ò' | 'Ó' | 'Ô' | 'Ø' => Some('O'),
        'ü' | 'ù' | 'ú' | 'û' => Some('u'),
        'Ü' | 'Ù' | 'Ú' | 'Û' => Some('U'),
        'é' | 'è' | 'ê' | 'ë' => Some('e'),
        'É' | 'È' | 'Ê' | 'Ë' => Some('E'),
        'í' | 'ì' | 'î' | 'ï' => Some('i'),
        'ç' => Some('c'),
        'Ç' => Some('C'),
        'ñ' => Some('n'),
        'Ñ' => Some('N'),
        'š' => Some('s'),
        'Š' => Some('S'),
        'ž' => Some('z'),
        'Ž' => Some('Z'),
        _ => None,
    };
    if let Some(b) = base {
        return glyph_width(b, bold);
    }
    match ch {
        'ß' => 611,
        '€' => 556,
        '§' => 556,
        '°' => 400,
        '×' | '÷' | '±' => 584,
        '–' => 556,
        '—' | '…' | '‰' => 1000,
        '•' => 350,
        '\u{00A0}' => 278,
        '„' | '“' | '”' => {
            if bold {
                500
            } else {
                333
            }
        }
        '‚' | '‘' | '’' => {
            if bold {
                278
            } else {
                222
            }
        }
        '²' | '³' | '¹' => 333,
        '½' | '¼' | '¾' => 834,
        _ => 556,
    }
}

/// Width of `s` in PDF points at `font_size`.
pub fn text_width_pt(s: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool) -> f64 {
    let units: u32 = s.chars().map(|c| glyph_width(c, bold)).sum();
    f64::from(units) * f64::from(font_size) / 1000.0
}

/// Largest prefix (in chars) of `s` that fits into `max_pt`.
fn advance_pt(s: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool) -> f64 {
    if super::unicode_font::needs_unicode(s) {
        super::unicode_font::width_pt(s, font_size)
    } else {
        text_width_pt(s, font_size, bold)
    }
}

pub fn fit_chars(s: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool, max_pt: f64) -> usize {
    let mut acc = 0.0;
    for (i, c) in s.chars().enumerate() {
        let piece: String = c.to_string();
        acc += advance_pt(&piece, font_size, bold);
        if acc > max_pt {
            return i;
        }
    }
    s.chars().count()
}

/// Wrap on whitespace so that every line fits into `max_pt`. Words longer
/// than the line are hard-broken (never silently clipped).
pub fn wrap_to_width(text: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool, max_pt: f64) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for paragraph in text.split('\n') {
        let trimmed = paragraph.trim_end();
        if trimmed.is_empty() {
            out.push(String::new());
            continue;
        }
        let mut cur = String::new();
        for word in trimmed.split_whitespace() {
            let candidate = if cur.is_empty() {
                word.to_string()
            } else {
                format!("{cur} {word}")
            };
            if advance_pt(&candidate, font_size, bold) <= max_pt {
                cur = candidate;
                continue;
            }
            if !cur.is_empty() {
                out.push(std::mem::take(&mut cur));
            }
            // Word alone too long → hard break.
            let mut rest: String = word.to_string();
            while advance_pt(&rest, font_size, bold) > max_pt {
                let n = fit_chars(&rest, font_size, bold, max_pt).max(1);
                let head: String = rest.chars().take(n).collect();
                out.push(head);
                rest = rest.chars().skip(n).collect();
            }
            cur = rest;
        }
        if !cur.is_empty() {
            out.push(cur);
        }
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        out.push(String::new());
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn digits_are_tabular() {
        assert_eq!(
            text_width_pt("1111", 10, false),
            text_width_pt("8888", 10, false)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn bold_is_wider_for_lowercase() {
        assert!(text_width_pt("abc", 10, true) > text_width_pt("abc", 10, false));
    }

    #[test]
    fn umlaut_matches_base() {
        assert_eq!(glyph_width('ä', false), glyph_width('a', false));
    }

    #[test]
    fn wrap_never_exceeds_width() {
        let lines = wrap_to_width(
            "Zahnfleischbluten Parodontalbehandlungsplanung extrem langes Wort",
            9,
            false,
            60.0,
        );
        assert!(lines.iter().all(|l| text_width_pt(l, 9, false) <= 60.0));
        assert!(lines.len() > 2);
    }
}
