fn bytes(p: &IssuedPdf) -> Vec<u8> {
    base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(&p.pdf_base64)
        .expect("base64")
}

/// WinAnsi bytes as Latin-1 text, with PDF string escapes resolved
/// (`\\ddd` octal, `\\(`, `\\)`, `\\\\`). Content streams are uncompressed.
fn text(pdf: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(pdf.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < pdf.len() {
        let b = pdf[i];
        if b == b'\\' && i + 1 < pdf.len() {
            let n = pdf[i + 1];
            if n.is_ascii_digit()
                && i + 3 < pdf.len()
                && pdf[i + 2].is_ascii_digit()
                && pdf[i + 3].is_ascii_digit()
            {
                let v = (n - b'0') as u32 * 64
                    + (pdf[i + 2] - b'0') as u32 * 8
                    + (pdf[i + 3] - b'0') as u32;
                out.push(char::from_u32(v).unwrap_or('?'));
                i += 4;
                continue;
            }
            if matches!(n, b'(' | b')' | b'\\') {
                out.push(n as char);
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
        }
        out.push(b as char);
        i += 1;
    }
    out
}

/// Text as it appears in the content stream (WinAnsi = Latin-1 for these chars).
fn latin1(s: &str) -> String {
    s.to_string()
}

/// Checks every official PDF must pass.
fn assert_official(name: &str, pdf: &[u8], number: Option<&str>) -> String {
    let path = out_dir().join(format!("{name}.pdf"));
    std::fs::write(&path, pdf).unwrap();
    let t = text(pdf);
    assert!(t.starts_with("%PDF-1."), "{name}: header");
    assert!(t.trim_end().ends_with("%%EOF"), "{name}: trailer");
    assert!(t.contains("/MediaBox [0 0 595"), "{name}: A4 page size");
    assert!(
        t.contains("/Lang (de-DE)") || t.contains("/Lang (de)"),
        "{name}: /Lang"
    );
    assert!(t.contains("/CreationDate (D:"), "{name}: CreationDate");
    assert!(t.contains("/Title ("), "{name}: Title");
    for needle in ["Zahnarztpraxis Dr. Anna Berger", "Seite 1 von"] {
        assert!(t.contains(&latin1(needle)), "{name}: missing {needle:?}");
    }
    // Legal identity on every official document (footer).
    for needle in ["66/123/45678", "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00"] {
        assert!(t.contains(needle), "{name}: footer missing {needle:?}");
    }
    if let Some(n) = number {
        assert!(t.contains(n), "{name}: document number {n} not printed");
    }
    assert!(
        !t.contains("ENTWURF"),
        "{name}: final document must not carry ENTWURF"
    );
    t
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn render_official_document_samples() {
    let pool = setup().await;
    let s = session();
    let year = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y").to_string();

    // ---- Invoice (GOZ Anlage 2) --------------------------------------------
    let line = |nr: &str, desc: &str, points: u32, factor: f64, tooth: Option<&str>| InvoiceLine {
        description: desc.into(),
        goz_nr: Some(nr.into()),
        points: Some(points),
        factor: Some(factor),
        quantity: Some(1),
        amount_cents: unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, points, factor),
        tooth_nr: tooth.map(String::from),
        treatment_date: Some("2026-11-02".into()),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let mut endo = line(
        "2410",
        "Aufbereitung eines Wurzelkanals",
        392,
        3.0,
        Some("36"),
    );
    endo.diagnosis_reason =
        Some("Stark gekrümmte, obliterierte Kanäle, erhöhter Zeitaufwand".into());
    let invoice = Invoice {
        recipient_name: "Lena Müller".into(),
        recipient_address: vec!["Musterweg 3".into(), "49076 Osnabrück".into()],
        lines: vec![
            line("0010", "Eingehende Untersuchung", 100, 2.3, None),
            line(
                "0090",
                "Intraorale Infiltrationsanästhesie",
                60,
                2.3,
                Some("36"),
            ),
            endo,
            InvoiceLine {
                description: "Wurzelfüllmaterial (Guttapercha, Sealer)".into(),
                fee_schedule: FeeSchedule::Material,
                amount_cents: 1850,
                quantity: Some(1),
                treatment_date: Some("2026-11-02".into()),
                ..Default::default()
            },
        ],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let inv = issue_invoice(
        &pool,
        &s,
        IssueInvoiceArgs {
            patient_id: "p1".into(),
            invoice,
            preview: false,
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("issue invoice");
    let inv_no = format!("RE-{year}-000001");
    assert_eq!(inv.document_number.as_deref(), Some(inv_no.as_str()));
    let t = assert_official("01-rechnung", &bytes(&inv), Some(&inv_no));
    for needle in [
        "GOZ",
        "Faktor",
        "2410",
        "Zwischensumme",
        "Rechnungsbetrag",
        "geb. 15.01.1990",
        "Leistungszeitraum",
        "Steuer-Nr. 66/123/45678",
        "Kammer: Zahnärztekammer Niedersachsen",
        "Tel. 0541 123456",
        "unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer",
        "4 Nr. 14",
        "Zahlbar innerhalb von 30 Tagen",
    ] {
        assert!(t.contains(&latin1(needle)), "invoice: missing {needle:?}");
    }
    // § 10 Abs. 3 GOZ justification is printed next to the 3.0 factor.
    assert!(t.contains("Kan"), "invoice: factor justification missing");

    // ---- Cancellation (Stornorechnung) ------------------------------------
    let storno = cancel_invoice(
        &pool,
        &s,
        inv.document_id.as_deref().unwrap(),
        "Rechnungsadresse falsch",
    )
    .await
    .expect("cancel");
    let st_no = format!("ST-{year}-000001");
    let t = assert_official("02-stornorechnung", &bytes(&storno), Some(&st_no));
    assert!(
        t.contains(&inv_no),
        "storno must reference the original invoice"
    );

    // ---- Certificate (AU): patient copy and employer copy -------------------
    let cert_layout = r#"{
      "kind": "certificate",
      "documentTitle": "ARBEITSUNFÄHIGKEITSBESCHEINIGUNG",
      "metaLines": [{"label": "Ausgestellt am", "value": "09.11.2026"}],
      "introParagraphs": ["Hiermit wird bescheinigt, dass die unten genannte Person arbeitsunfähig ist."],
      "twoColumn": {"leftTitle": "Patient/in", "leftLines": ["Lena Müller", "Geb.-Datum: 15.01.1990"],
                    "rightTitle": "Anschrift", "rightLines": ["Musterweg 3, 49076 Osnabrück"]},
      "labelValueRows": [
        {"label": "Festgestellt am", "value": "09.11.2026"},
        {"label": "Arbeitsunfähig von", "value": "09.11.2026"},
        {"label": "Voraussichtlich bis einschließlich", "value": "11.11.2026"},
        {"label": "Diagnose (ICD-10)", "value": "K04.0 Pulpitis", "confidential": true},
        {"label": "Befund", "value": "Akute Pulpitis 36", "confidential": true}
      ]
    }"#;
    let cert = |variant: &str| IssueClinicalArgs {
        kind: "certificate".into(),
        source_id: "c1".into(),
        layout_json: cert_layout.into(),
        preview: false,
        copy_variant: Some(variant.into()),
    };
    let patient_copy = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, cert("patient"))
        .await
        .expect("AU patient");
    let at_no = patient_copy.document_number.clone().unwrap();
    let t = assert_official("03-au-patient", &bytes(&patient_copy), Some(&at_no));
    assert!(t.contains("K04.0"), "patient copy keeps the diagnosis");
    // Patient identity comes from the database, not from the client layout.
    for needle in [
        "Lena Müller",
        "Geb.-Datum: 15.01.1990",
        "Vers.-Nr.: A123456789",
    ] {
        assert!(t.contains(needle), "AU: missing {needle:?}");
    }

    let employer_copy = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, cert("employer"))
        .await
        .expect("AU employer");
    let t = assert_official(
        "04-au-arbeitgeber",
        &bytes(&employer_copy),
        employer_copy.document_number.as_deref(),
    );
    assert!(
        !t.contains("K04.0") && !t.contains("Pulpitis"),
        "employer copy must not show the diagnosis"
    );
    assert!(t.contains("Arbeitgeber"), "employer copy is labelled");
    assert!(t.contains("Lena Müller"), "employer copy names the patient");
    assert!(
        !t.contains("A123456789"),
        "employer copy omits the insurance number"
    );

    // ---- Private prescription (AMVV § 2) ----------------------------------
    let rx_layout = r#"{
      "kind": "prescription",
      "documentTitle": "PRIVATREZEPT",
      "metaLines": [{"label": "Ausstellungsdatum", "value": "09.11.2026"}],
      "twoColumn": {"leftTitle": "Patient/in", "leftLines": ["Lena Müller", "Geb.-Datum: 15.01.1990"],
                    "rightTitle": "Anschrift", "rightLines": ["Musterweg 3, 49076 Osnabrück"]},
      "tables": [{"title": "Rp.", "columnLayout": "prescription",
        "headers": ["Arzneimittel / Stärke", "Darreichungsform", "Packung", "Dosierung", "PZN"],
        "rows": [["Ibuprofen 600 mg", "Filmtabletten", "1 × N1 (20 St.)", "1-0-1 nach dem Essen", "—"]]}],
      "labelValueRows": [{"label": "Dauer", "value": "5 Tage"},
                         {"label": "Aut idem", "value": "Austausch zulässig"}],
      "closingParagraphs": ["Privatrezept: gültig 3 Monate ab Ausstellungsdatum."]
    }"#;
    let rx = issue_clinical_document(
        &pool,
        &s,
        IssueClinicalArgs {
            kind: "prescription".into(),
            source_id: "rx1".into(),
            layout_json: rx_layout.into(),
            preview: false,
            copy_variant: None,
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("prescription");
    let t = assert_official(
        "05-privatrezept",
        &bytes(&rx),
        rx.document_number.as_deref(),
    );
    for needle in [
        "Ibuprofen 600 mg",
        "Filmtabletten",
        "1-0-1",
        "Dr. med. dent. Anna Berger",
        "ZANR 987654321",
    ] {
        assert!(t.contains(needle), "prescription: missing {needle:?}");
    }

    // ---- Receipt, reprint, preview ---------------------------------------
    let receipt_layout = r#"{
      "kind": "receipt",
      "documentTitle": "QUITTUNG",
      "metaLines": [{"label": "Zahlungsdatum", "value": "09.11.2026"}, {"label": "Zahlart", "value": "Karte"}],
      "addressLines": ["Lena Müller", "Musterweg 3", "49076 Osnabrück"],
      "tables": [{"columnLayout": "receipt", "headers": ["Datum", "Leistung", "Betrag"],
                  "rows": [["02.11.2026", "Wurzelkanalbehandlung 36", "112,24 EUR"], ["02.11.2026", "Anästhesie", "7,76 EUR"]]}],
      "totals": [{"label": "Rechnungsbetrag", "value": "120,00 EUR"},
                 {"label": "Erhaltener Betrag", "value": "120,00 EUR", "total": true},
                 {"label": "Noch offen", "value": "0,00 EUR"}],
      "closingParagraphs": ["Umsatzsteuerfrei gem. § 4 Nr. 14 Buchst. a UStG.", "Betrag dankend erhalten."]
    }"#;
    let receipt = |preview| IssueClinicalArgs {
        kind: "receipt".into(),
        source_id: "pay1".into(),
        layout_json: receipt_layout.into(),
        preview,
        copy_variant: None,
    };
    let preview = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, receipt(true))
        .await
        .expect("preview");
    assert!(preview.document_number.is_none());
    let preview_pdf = bytes(&preview);
    std::fs::write(out_dir().join("06-quittung-vorschau.pdf"), &preview_pdf).unwrap();
    assert!(
        text(&preview_pdf).contains("ENTWURF"),
        "preview carries ENTWURF"
    );

    let q = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, receipt(false))
        .await
        .expect("receipt");
    let qu_no = format!("QU-{year}-000001");
    let t = assert_official("07-quittung", &bytes(&q), Some(&qu_no));
    assert!(
        t.contains("Erhaltener Betrag") && t.contains("120,00"),
        "receipt totals"
    );

    let copy = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, receipt(false))
        .await
        .expect("reprint");
    assert!(copy.reprint);
    let t = assert_official("08-quittung-kopie", &bytes(&copy), Some(&qu_no));
    assert!(t.contains("KOPIE"), "reprint carries KOPIE");

    // ---- Day close → Kassenbericht (Tagesabschluss) ----------------------
    // Figures come from the cash journal; a client-built daily report is refused.
    let fake = ReportPdfInput {
        doc_title: "Tagesabschluss".into(),
        report_kind: Some("daily_report".into()),
        summary: vec![ReportPdfSummaryRow {
            label: "Einnahmen".into(),
            value: "1,00 EUR".into(),
        }],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    assert!(issue_report(&pool, &s, fake, None, false).await.is_err());
    let today = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string();
    let closed = cash_book::close_day(
        &pool,
        &s,
        CloseDayArgs {
            as_of_date: today,
            counted_cents: Some(0),
            card_terminal_cents: Some(12000),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("day close");
    let tb_no = format!("TB-{year}-000001");
    assert_eq!(
        closed.report.document_number.as_deref(),
        Some(tb_no.as_str())
    );
    let t = assert_official("09-tagesabschluss", &bytes(&closed.report), Some(&tb_no));
    for needle in [
        "Kassenbericht",
        "Soll-Bestand",
        "Ist-Bestand",
        "Kartenterminal",
        "Lena Müller",
        "Kassierer/in",
    ] {
        assert!(t.contains(needle), "Kassenbericht: missing {needle:?}");
    }

    eprintln!("PDF samples written to {}", out_dir().display());
}

================================================================================

//! P1 data-loss stops: a wrong key, a rekey, a failed migration, a restore,
//! and a staff delete each leave the original rows in place.

use std::sync::Mutex;

use medoc_core::infrastructure::backup;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::migrations::run_english_schema_upgrade;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::audit as audit_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::staff as staff_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sqlcipher;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;
use zeroize::Zeroizing;

const RIGHT_KEY_HEX: &str = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";
const WRONG_KEY_HEX: &str = "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210";

fn right_key() -> [u8; 32] {
    hex_key(RIGHT_KEY_HEX)
}

fn hex_key(hex: &str) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    for i in 0..32 {
        out[i] = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[i * 2..i * 2 + 2], 16).unwrap();
    }
    out
}

fn scratch(name: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("medoc-p1-{name}-{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("scratch dir");
    dir
}

fn lock_keys() -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, ()> {
    static LOCK: Mutex<()> = Mutex::new(());
    let guard = LOCK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|poisoned| poisoned.into_inner());
    std::env::set_var("MEDOC_DB_KEY", RIGHT_KEY_HEX);
    std::env::set_var("MEDOC_AUDIT_KEY", "k9-medoc-test-audit-key-32bytes!");
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_VENDOR_PUBKEY",
        "79c1662a9e6877dd6b2156324ee33b969e1076393a91fbe9b2976596dca81b32",
    );
    guard
}

async fn marker_value(pool: &SqlitePool) -> String {
    sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT v FROM p1_marker")
        .fetch_one(pool)
        .await
        .expect("marker row")
}

async fn write_marker(pool: &SqlitePool, value: &str) {
    sqlx::query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS p1_marker (v TEXT NOT NULL)")
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .expect("create marker");
    sqlx::query("DELETE FROM p1_marker")
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    sqlx::query("INSERT INTO p1_marker (v) VALUES (?1)")
        .bind(value)
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn wrong_key_leaves_the_database_file_and_its_rows() {
    let _guard = lock_keys();
    let dir = scratch("wrong-key");
    let db_path = dir.join("medoc.db");
    let key = Zeroizing::new(right_key().to_vec());
    let pool = sqlcipher::open_encrypted_pool(&db_path, key, true)
        .await
        .expect("create encrypted db");
    write_marker(&pool, "keep-me").await;
    pool.close().await;

    std::env::set_var("MEDOC_DB_KEY", WRONG_KEY_HEX);
    let opened = connection::open_pool_with_migrations(&dir).await;
    assert!(
        opened.is_err(),
        "a wrong key must not open the practice database"
    );
    assert!(db_path.exists(), "a wrong key must not quarantine medoc.db");

    let pool =
        sqlcipher::open_encrypted_pool(&db_path, Zeroizing::new(right_key().to_vec()), false)
            .await
            .expect("original key still opens the file");
    assert_eq!(marker_value(&pool).await, "keep-me");
    pool.close().await;
    std::env::set_var("MEDOC_DB_KEY", RIGHT_KEY_HEX);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn activation_rekey_keeps_existing_rows() {
    let _guard = lock_keys();
    let dir = scratch("rekey");
    let db_path = dir.join("medoc.db");
    let old = right_key();
    let new = hex_key(WRONG_KEY_HEX);
    let pool = sqlcipher::open_encrypted_pool(&db_path, Zeroizing::new(old.to_vec()), true)
        .await
        .expect("create");
    write_marker(&pool, "before-activation").await;
    pool.close().await;

    sqlcipher::rekey_database_file(&db_path, &old, &new)
        .await
        .expect("activation rekey");
    assert!(db_path.exists(), "rekey must not delete medoc.db");
    assert!(
        !sqlcipher::opens_with_sqlcipher_key(&db_path, &old).await,
        "the old key must stop working"
    );
    let pool = sqlcipher::open_encrypted_pool(&db_path, Zeroizing::new(new.to_vec()), false)
        .await
        .expect("new key opens the same file");
    assert_eq!(marker_value(&pool).await, "before-activation");
    pool.close().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn plaintext_backup_is_removed_after_encryption() {
    let _guard = lock_keys();
    let dir = scratch("plain");
    let db_path = dir.join("medoc.db");
    let opts = sqlx::sqlite::SqliteConnectOptions::new()
        .filename(&db_path)
        .create_if_missing(true);
    let pool = sqlx::sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions::new()
        .max_connections(1)
        .connect_with(opts)
        .await
        .expect("plaintext db");
    write_marker(&pool, "plain-row").await;
    pool.close().await;

    sqlcipher::migrate_plaintext_to_sqlcipher(&db_path, &right_key())
        .await
        .expect("encrypt");
    let backup = db_path.with_extension("db.plain-backup");
    assert!(
        !backup.exists(),
        "plaintext sibling must be deleted after encryption"
    );
    let pool =
        sqlcipher::open_encrypted_pool(&db_path, Zeroizing::new(right_key().to_vec()), false)
            .await
            .expect("encrypted file opens");
    assert_eq!(marker_value(&pool).await, "plain-row");
    pool.close().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn validate_open_accepts_only_the_practice_key() {
    let _guard = lock_keys();
    let dir = scratch("validate");
    let db_path = dir.join("medoc.db");
    let pool = sqlcipher::open_encrypted_pool(&db_path, Zeroizing::new(right_key().to_vec()), true)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    write_marker(&pool, "sealed").await;
    pool.close().await;

    assert!(backup::validate_open(&db_path, &right_key()).await.unwrap());
    assert!(!backup::validate_open(&db_path, &hex_key(WRONG_KEY_HEX))
        .await
        .unwrap());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn failed_migration_leaves_existing_rows_and_foreign_keys_on() {
    let _guard = lock_keys();
    std::env::set_var("MEDOC_DEV_SEED", "1");
    let dir = scratch("fk");
    let pool = connection::init_db_headless(&dir).await.expect("init");
    let before: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff")
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(before > 0, "seed staff");

    let mut conn = pool.acquire().await.unwrap();
    sqlx::query("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
        .execute(&mut *conn)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sick_leave_certificate
            (id, staff_id, document_ref, date_from, created_by, created_at)
         VALUES ('orphan-leave', 'no-such-staff', 'doc', '2026-01-01', 'no-such-staff', '2026-01-01')",
    )
    .execute(&mut *conn)
    .await
    .expect("orphan insert while foreign keys are off");
    sqlx::query("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        .execute(&mut *conn)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    drop(conn);

    let err = run_english_schema_upgrade(&pool)
        .await
        .expect_err("foreign_key_check must fail while the orphan row exists");
    assert!(
        err.to_string().contains("foreign_key_check"),
        "unexpected error: {err}"
    );
    let after: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff")
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(before, after, "a failed migration must keep the staff rows");
    let fk: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("PRAGMA foreign_keys")
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fk, 1, "foreign keys stay on after the failed check");
    pool.close().await;
    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_DEV_SEED");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn restore_reopen_in_process_keeps_the_backup_rows() {
    let _guard = lock_keys();
    let dir = scratch("restore");
    let backups = dir.join("backups");
    std::env::set_var("MEDOC_BACKUP_DIR", &backups);
    let pool = connection::init_db_headless(&dir).await.expect("init");
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO app_kv (key, value) VALUES ('p1-restore', 'from-backup')
         ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let snapshot = backup::create(&pool).await.expect("backup");

    sqlx::query("UPDATE app_kv SET value = 'live-edit' WHERE key = 'p1-restore'")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    backup::restore_from_backup(&pool, &dir, &snapshot)
        .await
        .expect("restore");
    let reopened = connection::reopen_app_pool(&dir).await.expect("reopen");
    let value: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT value FROM app_kv WHERE key = 'p1-restore'")
        .fetch_one(&reopened)
        .await
        .expect("restored row");
    assert_eq!(value, "from-backup");
    reopened.close().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn staff_delete_keeps_another_staff_members_sick_leave() {
    let _guard = lock_keys();
    std::env::set_var("MEDOC_DEV_SEED", "1");
    let dir = scratch("staff");
    let pool = connection::init_db_headless(&dir).await.expect("init");
    let subject: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT id FROM staff ORDER BY id LIMIT 1")
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("seed staff");
    medoc_core::mvp_security::drop_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("quota triggers");
    let removed = "p1-reception-author";
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role)
         VALUES (?1, 'P1 Reception', 'p1-reception@practice.test', 'hash', 'RECEPTION')",
    )
    .bind(removed)
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("reception author");

    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sick_leave_certificate
            (id, staff_id, document_ref, date_from, created_by, created_at)
         VALUES ('keep-leave', ?1, 'doc', '2026-01-01', ?2, '2026-01-01')",
    )
    .bind(&subject)
    .bind(&removed)
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("sick leave for the other staff member");

    staff_repo::delete(&pool, &removed)
        .await
        .expect("delete the author");
    let kept: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sick_leave_certificate WHERE id = 'keep-leave'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        kept, 1,
        "sick leave owned by another staff member must stay"
    );
    pool.close().await;
    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_DEV_SEED");
}

}

//! Part E: patients, chart, scheduling (F59, F60, F63, F65, F67, F69, F70, F94, F99).

use chrono::NaiveDate;
use medoc_core::domain::entities::appointment::{
    AppointmentMove, CreateAppointment, UpdateAppointment,
};
use medoc_core::domain::entities::patient::{CreatePatient, UpdatePatient};

const DOC: &str = "seed-physician-001";

async fn pool() -> SqlitePool {

}

async fn patient(pool: &SqlitePool, name: &str) -> String {
    patient_repo::create(
        pool,
        &CreatePatient {
            name: name.into(),
            date_of_birth: NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(1985, 5, 5).unwrap(),
            sex: Sex::Female,
            insurance_number: format!("INS-{name}"),
            phone: Some("0541 123".into()),
            email: Some(format!("{name}@example.org")),
            address: Some("Street 1".into()),

    )
    .await
    .unwrap()
    .id
}

        patient_id: patient_id.into(),
        physician_id: DOC.into(),

        chief_complaint: None,

    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn overlapping_appointments_conflict_and_cancelled_does_not_block() {
    let pool = pool().await;
    let pid = patient(&pool, "overlap").await;
    let first = appointment_repo::create(&pool, &appt(&pid, "2099-04-01", "09:00", Some(60)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(first.duration_minutes, 60);
    // 09:30 starts inside 09:00-10:00.
    let err = appointment_repo::create(&pool, &appt(&pid, "2099-04-01", "09:30", Some(30)))
        .await
        .expect_err("overlap");
    assert!(matches!(err, AppError::Conflict(_)));
    // 10:00 starts exactly when the first ends.
    appointment_repo::create(&pool, &appt(&pid, "2099-04-01", "10:00", Some(30)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    // Cancel the first; its slot frees up.
    sqlx::query("UPDATE appointment SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = ?1")
        .bind(&first.id)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    appointment_repo::create(&pool, &appt(&pid, "2099-04-01", "09:30", Some(30)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
}

        .await
        .unwrap();

    );

#[tokio::test]
async fn move_appointments_is_all_or_nothing() {
    let pool = pool().await;
    let pid = patient(&pool, "move").await;
    let a = appointment_repo::create(&pool, &appt(&pid, "2099-06-01", "09:00", Some(30)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let b = appointment_repo::create(&pool, &appt(&pid, "2099-06-01", "10:00", Some(30)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let _c = appointment_repo::create(&pool, &appt(&pid, "2099-06-02", "09:00", Some(30)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    // Swapping a and b is fine (moved rows leave their old slots).
    let moved = appointment_repo::move_many(
        &pool,
        &[
            AppointmentMove {
                id: a.id.clone(),
                date: "2099-06-01".into(),
                time: "10:00".into(),
            },
            AppointmentMove {
                id: b.id.clone(),
                date: "2099-06-01".into(),
                time: "09:00".into(),
            },
        ],
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(moved.len(), 2);
    // a onto c's slot conflicts: nothing moves, b included.
    let err = appointment_repo::move_many(
        &pool,
        &[
            AppointmentMove {
                id: b.id.clone(),
                date: "2099-06-03".into(),
                time: "09:00".into(),
            },
            AppointmentMove {
                id: a.id.clone(),
                date: "2099-06-02".into(),
                time: "09:15".into(),
            },
        ],
    )
    .await
    .expect_err("conflict");
    assert!(matches!(err, AppError::Conflict(_)));
    let b_now: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT date FROM appointment WHERE id = ?1")
        .bind(&b.id)
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b_now, "2099-06-01");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn badge_count_equals_list_total() {
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::clinical::chart;
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::scheduling::practice_task as tasks;
    let pool = pool().await;

    {
        let mut conn = pool.acquire().await.unwrap();
        sqlx::query("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
            .execute(&mut *conn)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO patient_chart (id, patient_id, status) VALUES ('orphan-chart', 'no-such-patient', 'DRAFT')")
            .execute(&mut *conn)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        sqlx::query("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
            .execute(&mut *conn)
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }
    let list = chart::list_charts_to_validate(&pool).await.unwrap();
    let count = chart::count_charts_to_validate(&pool).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(count as usize, list.len());

    let rez = "seed-rez-001";
    let total_lists = tasks::list_inbox_reception(&pool, 1000)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .len()
        + tasks::list_outgoing_reception(&pool, rez, 1000)
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .len()
        + tasks::list_pending_validation(&pool, rez, 1000)
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .len();
    assert_eq!(
        tasks::count_open_for_reception(&pool, rez).await.unwrap() as usize,
        total_lists
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn legacy_notes_duration_is_backfilled() {
    let pool = pool().await;
    let pid = patient(&pool, "backfill").await;
    // Pre-F65 database: no column, duration only in the notes text.
    sqlx::query("ALTER TABLE appointment DROP COLUMN duration_minutes")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    for (id, notes) in [
        ("legacy-45", "Duration: 45 min · bring x-ray"),
        ("legacy-none", "no length"),
    ] {
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO appointment (id, date, time, kind, status, patient_id, physician_id, notes)
             VALUES (?1, '2099-07-01', '09:00', 'CHECKUP', 'PLANNED', ?2, ?3, ?4)",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .bind(&pid)
        .bind(DOC)
        .bind(notes)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    }
    run_migrations(&pool).await.unwrap();
    let d45: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT duration_minutes FROM appointment WHERE id = 'legacy-45'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
    let d30: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT duration_minutes FROM appointment WHERE id = 'legacy-none'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
    assert_eq!((d45, d30), (45, 30));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn payment_after_local_midnight_is_in_new_day() {
    let pool = pool().await;
    let pid = patient(&pool, "midnight").await;
    // 23:30 UTC on 9 Nov = 00:30 on 10 Nov in Berlin.
    raw_payment(&pool, "pay-late", &pid, 10.0, "PAID", "2026-11-09 23:30:00").await;
    raw_payment(&pool, "pay-day", &pid, 20.0, "PAID", "2026-11-09 10:00:00").await;
    let on = |d: &'static str| payment_repo::PaymentListFilter {
        date_on: Some(d),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let (day10, _) = payment_repo::find_paginated(&pool, 100, 0, "ASC", on("2026-11-10"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let (day9, _) = payment_repo::find_paginated(&pool, 100, 0, "ASC", on("2026-11-09"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        day10.iter().map(|p| p.id.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        vec!["pay-late"]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        day9.iter().map(|p| p.id.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        vec!["pay-day"]
    );
}

/// "Impossible de charger les paiements … no column found for name: updated_at":
/// the patient's payment list must load on databases with and without
/// `payment.updated_at`.
#[tokio::test]
async fn patient_payments_load_with_and_without_updated_at_column() {
    let pool = pool().await;
    let pid = patient(&pool, "cols").await;
    raw_payment(&pool, "pay-cols", &pid, 12.5, "PAID", "2026-11-08 09:00:00").await;
    let rows = payment_repo::find_by_patient_id(&pool, &pid)
        .await
        .expect("with column");
    assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1);
    assert!(rows[0].updated_at.is_some());
    // Older database shape, on a fresh pool (sqlx caches prepared column lists).
    let legacy = super_pool_without_updated_at().await;
    let pid2 = patient(&legacy, "cols-legacy").await;
    raw_payment_no_updated(&legacy, "pay-legacy", &pid2, 12.5).await;
    let rows = payment_repo::find_by_patient_id(&legacy, &pid2)
        .await
        .expect("without column");
    assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1);
    assert!((rows[0].amount - 12.5).abs() < 1e-9);
    assert!(rows[0].updated_at.is_none());
}

async fn super_pool_without_updated_at() -> SqlitePool {
    let p = pool().await;
    sqlx::query("ALTER TABLE payment DROP COLUMN updated_at")
        .execute(&p)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    p
}

================================================================================
FILE: tests/recorded_write_guard.rs
================================================================================
//! H2: every repo write of a synced table goes through `record_in_tx`.

use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::{synced_tables, SyncClass, TABLES};
use regex::Regex;
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;

#[test]
fn every_synced_write_is_recorded() {
    let root = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("src/infrastructure/database/repos");
    scan_and_assert(&[root], false);
}

/// F145: writes outside `repos/` (desktop commands, core services) must be
/// recorded too. `app_kv` is skipped here because its keys decide whether a
/// write syncs; app_kv writes go through `app_kv_repo`, which records.
#[test]
fn command_and_service_writes_are_recorded() {
    let core = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
    let roots = vec![
        core.join("../../app/medoc-practice/src/commands"),
        core.join("src/infrastructure/gdpr.rs"),
        core.join("src/infrastructure/migration.rs"),
        core.join("src/application"),
    ];
    scan_and_assert(&roots, true);
}

fn scan_and_assert(roots: &[std::path::PathBuf], skip_app_kv: bool) {
    let synced: Vec<&str> = synced_tables().collect();
    let sql_re =
        Regex::new(r#"(?i)(INSERT\s+INTO|UPDATE|DELETE\s+FROM)\s+["']?([a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)"#)
            .expect("sql re");
    let fn_re =
        Regex::new(r"(?m)^(?:\s*(?:pub(?:\([^)]+\))?\s+)?)?(?:async\s+)?fn\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)")
            .expect("fn re");
    let mut offenders = Vec::new();
    for root in roots {
        visit_rs(root, &mut |path, src| {
            let src = match src.find("#[cfg(test)]") {
                Some(i) => &src[..i],
                None => src,
            };
            let mut starts: Vec<(usize, &str)> = fn_re
                .captures_iter(src)
                .map(|c| (c.get(0).unwrap().start(), c.get(1).unwrap().as_str()))
                .collect();
            starts.push((src.len(), ""));
            for window in starts.windows(2) {
                let (start, name) = window[0];
                let end = window[1].0;
                let body = &src[start..end];
                let recorded = body.contains("record_in_tx")
                    || body.contains("record_or_noop")
                    || body.contains("record_row(")
                    || body.contains("sync: recorded by caller");
                for cap in sql_re.captures_iter(body) {
                    let kind = cap.get(1).unwrap().as_str().to_ascii_uppercase();
                    let table = cap.get(2).unwrap().as_str();
                    if !synced.iter().any(|t| *t == table) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if skip_app_kv && table == "app_kv" {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if !recorded {
                        offenders.push(format!(
                            "{}::{name}: {kind} {table} without record_in_tx",
                            path.display()
                        ));
                    }
                    if kind == "UPDATE" && !body.contains("updated_at") {
                        offenders.push(format!(
                            "{}::{name}: UPDATE {table} missing updated_at",
                            path.display()
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
    let _classes: Vec<_> = TABLES
        .iter()
        .filter(|(_, c)| *c != SyncClass::DeviceLocal)
        .collect();
    assert!(
        offenders.is_empty(),
        "H2 offenders ({}):\n{}",
        offenders.len(),
        offenders.join("\n")
    );
}

fn visit_rs(dir: &Path, on_file: &mut impl FnMut(&Path, &str)) {
    if dir.is_file() {
        let src = fs::read_to_string(dir).expect("read rs");
        on_file(dir, &src);
        return;
    }
    let entries = fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("read {}: {e}", dir.display()));
    for entry in entries {
        let entry = entry.expect("dirent");
        let path = entry.path();
        if path.is_dir() {
            visit_rs(&path, on_file);
        } else if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
            let src = fs::read_to_string(&path).expect("read rs");
            on_file(&path, &src);
        }
    }
}

================================================================================

//! Removing a staff row must not hit SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY (787).

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::crypto;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::staff as staff_repo;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

async fn fresh_pool() -> SqlitePool {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    pool
}

/// The test database has no demo seed, so create one appointment for the
/// seeded physician explicitly.
async fn seed_appointment_for(pool: &SqlitePool, physician_id: &str) {
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status)
         VALUES ('fk-patient-1', 'FK Patient', '1980-01-01', 'MALE', 'FK-INS-1', 'ACTIVE')",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO appointment (id, date, time, kind, status, patient_id, physician_id)
         VALUES ('fk-apt-1', '2026-11-10', '09:00', 'CHECKUP', 'PLANNED', 'fk-patient-1', ?1)",
    )
    .bind(physician_id)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
}

async fn insert_staff(pool: &SqlitePool, id: &str, role: &str) {
    let hash = crypto::hash_password("TestPass42").unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)",
    )
    .bind(id)
    .bind(format!("User {id}"))
    .bind(format!("{id}@practice.de"))
    .bind(&hash)
    .bind(role)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn delete_reception_with_work_time_does_not_fk_fail() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO work_time_session (id, staff_id, started_at, status)
         VALUES ('wt-1', 'seed-rez-001', datetime('now'), 'ENDED')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO work_time_pause_segment (id, session_id, started_at, ended_at)
         VALUES ('wt-pause-1', 'wt-1', datetime('now'), datetime('now'))",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();

    staff_repo::delete(&pool, "seed-rez-001")
        .await
        .expect("delete reception");
    let n: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE id = 'seed-rez-001'")
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(n, 0);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn delete_physician_reassigns_appointments_when_another_exists() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    medoc_core::mvp_security::drop_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("drop quota");
    insert_staff(&pool, "doc-b", "PHYSICIAN").await;
    seed_appointment_for(&pool, "seed-physician-001").await;
    medoc_core::mvp_security::ensure_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("quota");

    staff_repo::delete(&pool, "seed-physician-001")
        .await
        .expect("delete physician");
    let n: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE physician_id = 'seed-physician-001'",
    )
    .fetch_one(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(n, 0);
    let left: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE physician_id = 'doc-b'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
    assert!(left > 0);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn delete_last_physician_with_appointments_is_blocked() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    seed_appointment_for(&pool, "seed-physician-001").await;
    let err = staff_repo::delete(&pool, "seed-physician-001")
        .await
        .expect_err("must block last clinician");
    assert!(matches!(err, AppError::Validation(_)));
}

//! Staff quota enforcement (MVP: 1 PHYSICIAN + 4 RECEPTION, 5 total).

use medoc_core::domain::entities::staff::{CreateStaff, UpdateStaff};
use medoc_core::domain::enums::Role;
use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::crypto;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::test_memory_pool;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::staff as staff_repo;
use medoc_core::mvp_security;

async fn staff_only_pool() -> sqlx::SqlitePool {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE staff (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            role TEXT NOT NULL,
            activity_area TEXT,
            specialty TEXT,
            phone TEXT,
            available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            totp_secret TEXT,
            totp_enrolled_at TEXT,
            token_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("staff table");
    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_kv (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            value TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("app_kv");
    mvp_security::ensure_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("staff quota triggers");
    pool
}

async fn insert_staff(pool: &sqlx::SqlitePool, id: &str, role: &str) {
    let hash = crypto::hash_password("TestPass42").unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)",
    )
    .bind(id)
    .bind(format!("User {id}"))
    .bind(format!("{id}@practice.de"))
    .bind(&hash)
    .bind(role)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
}

fn sample_create(email: &str, role: Role) -> CreateStaff {
    CreateStaff {
        name: "New User".into(),
        email: email.into(),
        password: "SecurePass42".into(),
        role,
        activity_area: None,
        specialty: None,
        phone: None,
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn staff_quota_counts_roles() {
    let pool = staff_only_pool().await;
    insert_staff(&pool, "a1", "PHYSICIAN").await;
    insert_staff(&pool, "r1", "RECEPTION").await;

    let q = mvp_security::staff_quota(&pool).await.expect("quota");
    assert_eq!(q.used_physician, 1);
    assert_eq!(q.used_reception, 1);
    assert_eq!(q.max_total, mvp_security::MAX_TOTAL_STAFF);
}

    insert_staff(&pool, "r1", "RECEPTION").await;

    let data = UpdateStaff {
        name: None,
        email: None,
        role: Some(Role::Physician),
        activity_area: None,
        specialty: None,
        phone: None,
        available: None,

                msg.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("physician"),

    }

#[tokio::test]
async fn create_with_quota_concurrent_boundary_allows_only_one() {
    let pool = staff_only_pool().await;
    insert_staff(&pool, "a1", "PHYSICIAN").await;
    for i in 1..=3 {
        insert_staff(&pool, &format!("r{i}"), "RECEPTION").await;
    }

    let hash = crypto::hash_password("SecurePass42").unwrap();
    let data_a = sample_create("new-a@practice.de", Role::Reception);
    let data_b = sample_create("new-b@practice.de", Role::Reception);

    let (res_a, res_b) = tokio::join!(
        staff_repo::create_with_quota(&pool, &data_a, &hash),
        staff_repo::create_with_quota(&pool, &data_b, &hash),
    );

    let successes = [res_a.is_ok(), res_b.is_ok()]
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|ok| *ok)
        .count();
    assert_eq!(successes, 1, "exactly one concurrent create may succeed");

    let failures = [res_a.err(), res_b.err()].into_iter().flatten().count();
    assert_eq!(failures, 1, "exactly one concurrent create must fail");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn create_with_quota_concurrent_boundary_stable_under_repetition() {
    for attempt in 0..30 {
        let pool = staff_only_pool().await;
        insert_staff(&pool, "a1", "PHYSICIAN").await;
        for i in 1..=3 {
            insert_staff(&pool, &format!("r{i}"), "RECEPTION").await;
        }

        let hash = crypto::hash_password("SecurePass42").unwrap();
        let data_a = sample_create(&format!("rep-a-{attempt}@practice.de"), Role::Reception);
        let data_b = sample_create(&format!("rep-b-{attempt}@practice.de"), Role::Reception);

        let (res_a, res_b) = tokio::join!(
            staff_repo::create_with_quota(&pool, &data_a, &hash),
            staff_repo::create_with_quota(&pool, &data_b, &hash),
        );

        let successes = [res_a.is_ok(), res_b.is_ok()]
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|ok| *ok)
            .count();
        assert_eq!(
            successes, 1,
            "attempt {attempt}: exactly one concurrent create may succeed"
        );
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn update_with_quota_concurrent_promote_to_physician_allows_only_one() {
    for attempt in 0..25 {
        let pool = staff_only_pool().await;
        insert_staff(&pool, &format!("r1-{attempt}"), "RECEPTION").await;
        insert_staff(&pool, &format!("r2-{attempt}"), "RECEPTION").await;

        let id1 = format!("r1-{attempt}");
        let id2 = format!("r2-{attempt}");
        let data = UpdateStaff {
            name: None,
            email: None,
            role: Some(Role::Physician),
            activity_area: None,
            specialty: None,
            phone: None,
            available: None,
        };

        let (res_a, res_b) = tokio::join!(
            staff_repo::update_with_quota(&pool, &id1, &data, "PHYSICIAN"),
            staff_repo::update_with_quota(&pool, &id2, &data, "PHYSICIAN"),
        );

        let successes = [res_a.is_ok(), res_b.is_ok()]
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|ok| *ok)
            .count();
        assert_eq!(
            successes, 1,
            "attempt {attempt}: exactly one concurrent PHYSICIAN promotion may succeed"
        );

        let physician_count: (i64,) =
            sqlx::query_as("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE UPPER(role) = 'PHYSICIAN'")
                .fetch_one(&pool)
                .await
                .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(physician_count.0, 1);
    }
}

/// F144: an install created by the legacy schema keeps its rows and gains the
/// new status values after `run_migrations`.
#[tokio::test]
async fn legacy_database_gets_widened_status_checks_and_keeps_rows() {
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::migrations::run_legacy_embedded_migrations;
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_legacy_embedded_migrations(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("legacy schema");
    let old_sql: String =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'patient'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
    assert!(
        !old_sql.contains("ARCHIVED"),
        "precondition: legacy CHECK lacks ARCHIVED"
    );

    for sql in [
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role) VALUES ('st-1','Doc','doc@x.de','h','PHYSICIAN')",
        "INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status) VALUES ('p-1','A','1990-01-01','MALE','INS-1','ACTIVE')",
        "INSERT INTO patient_chart (id, patient_id, status) VALUES ('c-1','p-1','DRAFT')",
        "INSERT INTO appointment (id, date, time, kind, status, patient_id, physician_id) VALUES ('a-1','2026-11-10','09:00','CHECKUP','PLANNED','p-1','st-1')",
    ] {
        sqlx::query(sql).execute(&pool).await.expect(sql);
    }

    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("upgrade");

    sqlx::query("UPDATE patient SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE id = 'p-1'")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("ARCHIVED after upgrade");
    sqlx::query("UPDATE patient_chart SET status = 'DECLINED' WHERE id = 'c-1'")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("DECLINED after upgrade");
    sqlx::query("UPDATE appointment SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS' WHERE id = 'a-1'")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("IN_PROGRESS after upgrade");

    let fks: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('appointment')")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
    assert!(fks >= 2, "appointment keeps its foreign keys");
    let orphan = sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO appointment (id, date, time, kind, status, patient_id, physician_id)
         VALUES ('a-bad','2026-11-10','10:00','CHECKUP','PLANNED','missing','st-1')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await;
    assert!(
        orphan.is_err(),
        "foreign keys still enforced after the rebuild"
    );
    let rows: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE id = 'a-1'")
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rows, 1);
    let bad_status = sqlx::query("UPDATE patient SET status = 'NONSENSE' WHERE id = 'p-1'")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await;
    assert!(bad_status.is_err(), "CHECK still rejects unknown values");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn payment_status_rejects_unknown_value_and_reopening() {
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::billing::payment as payment_repo;
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status)
         VALUES ('p-pay','A','1990-01-01','MALE','INS-PAY','ACTIVE')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO payment (id, patient_id, amount, payment_method, status)
         VALUES ('pay-1','p-pay',10.0,'CASH','OUTSTANDING')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert!(payment_repo::update_status(&pool, "pay-1", "WHATEVER")
        .await
        .is_err());
    payment_repo::update_status(&pool, "pay-1", "PAID")
        .await
        .expect("OUTSTANDING -> PAID");
    assert!(
        payment_repo::update_status(&pool, "pay-1", "OUTSTANDING")
            .await
            .is_err(),
        "PAID cannot be reopened"
    );
}

#[test]
fn patient_status_is_forward_only_except_archive() {
    use medoc_core::domain::status::PatientStatus;
    assert!(PatientStatus::require_transition("NEW", "ACTIVE").is_ok());
    assert!(PatientStatus::require_transition("VALIDATED", "ACTIVE").is_err());
    assert!(PatientStatus::require_transition("READONLY", "ARCHIVED").is_ok());
    assert!(PatientStatus::require_transition("ARCHIVED", "ACTIVE").is_ok());
    assert!(PatientStatus::require_transition("ACTIVE", "BOGUS").is_err());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn partially_paid_payment_cannot_be_deleted() {
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.unwrap();
    run_migrations(&pool).await.unwrap();
    sqlx::query("INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status) VALUES ('pp-1','P','1980-01-01','MALE','PP-1','ACTIVE')")
        .execute(&pool).await.unwrap();
    for (id, st) in [("pay-open", "OUTSTANDING"), ("pay-part", "PARTIALLY_PAID")] {
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO payment (id, patient_id, amount, payment_method, status) VALUES (?1,'pp-1',50,'CASH',?2)")
            .bind(id).bind(st).execute(&pool).await.unwrap();
    }
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::billing::payment as pay;
    assert!(pay::delete_if_pending(&pool, "pay-part").await.is_err());
    pay::delete_if_pending(&pool, "pay-open")
        .await
        .expect("open payment deletes");
    let left: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment WHERE id IN ('pay-open','pay-part')")
            .fetch_one(&pool)

            .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(left, 1);
}

//! Slice 5 — auto outbox hook coverage tests.
//!
//! Each test enables `serverless_peer` mode through `app_kv`, performs one
//! write on a hooked repository, and confirms that exactly **one** row was
//! appended to `sync_outbox`. Tables not on the allow-list must produce zero
//! rows.
//!
//! These tests intentionally exercise the public repository API rather than
//! `record_or_noop` directly so we catch the wiring at call sites.

use chrono::NaiveDate;
use medoc_core::domain::entities::appointment::{CreateAppointment, UpdateAppointment};
use medoc_core::domain::entities::patient::CreatePatient;
use medoc_core::domain::entities::practice_task::CreatePracticeTask;
use medoc_core::domain::entities::prescription::CreatePrescription;
use medoc_core::domain::enums::{AppointmentKind, Sex};
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::app_kv as app_kv_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::billing::payment as payment_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::clinical::chart as chart_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::clinical::patient as patient_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::clinical::prescription as prescription_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::scheduling::appointment as appointment_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::scheduling::practice_task as practice_task_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::scheduling::practice_ticket as practice_ticket_repo;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

async fn fresh_pool() -> SqlitePool {
    let pool = connection::test_memory_pool().await.expect("memory pool");
    connection::run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrations");
    pool
}

async fn enable_serverless(pool: &SqlitePool) {
    app_kv_repo::set(
        pool,
        "sync.deployment.v1",
        r#"{"schemaVersion":1,"mode":"serverless_peer","role":"REPLICA","masterBaseUrl":"","masterCertSha256":"","masterAccessToken":"","deviceLabel":"Tester"}"#,
    )
    .await
    .expect("enable serverless");
}

async fn outbox_count(pool: &SqlitePool, table: &str) -> i64 {
    sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity_table = ?1")
        .bind(table)
        .fetch_one(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap()
}

fn sample_patient(name: &str) -> CreatePatient {
    CreatePatient {
        name: name.into(),
        date_of_birth: NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(1990, 1, 1).unwrap(),
        sex: Sex::Male,
        insurance_number: format!("V-{}", name),
        phone: None,
        email: None,
        address: None,
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn patient_create_emits_one_outbox_row_per_table() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    enable_serverless(&pool).await;

    let p = patient_repo::create(&pool, &sample_patient("alpha"))
        .await
        .expect("create patient");

    assert_eq!(outbox_count(&pool, "patient").await, 1);
    assert_eq!(outbox_count(&pool, "patient_chart").await, 1);
    assert_eq!(outbox_count(&pool, "anamnesis_form").await, 1);
    // `staff` is not on SYNCED_TABLES.
    assert_eq!(outbox_count(&pool, "staff").await, 0);

    let _ = p.id;
}

async fn patient_update_and_delete_each_record_one_row() {

    enable_serverless(&pool).await;

        .await
        .expect("create patient");

        &pool,

        &medoc_core::domain::entities::patient::UpdatePatient {
            name: Some("beta-updated".into()),
            phone: None,
            email: None,
            address: None,
            status: None,
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("update");

#[tokio::test]
async fn appointment_lifecycle_emits_three_outbox_rows() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    enable_serverless(&pool).await;

    // Need a patient for the FK on appointment (the create handler computes
    // patient label via JOIN — but the create_appointment function only needs
    // the patient id to exist).
    let p = patient_repo::create(&pool, &sample_patient("delta"))
        .await
        .expect("create patient");

    // Migrations already seed the single MVP PHYSICIAN (`seed-physician-001`).
    let create = CreateAppointment {
        patient_id: p.id.clone(),
        date: "2099-01-01".into(),
        time: "09:00".into(),
        kind: AppointmentKind::Checkup,
        notes: None,
        chief_complaint: None,
        physician_id: "seed-physician-001".into(),
        duration_minutes: None,
        status: None,
    };
    let t = appointment_repo::create(&pool, &create)
        .await
        .expect("create");

    appointment_repo::update(
        &pool,
        &t.id,
        &UpdateAppointment {
            date: Some("2099-01-02".into()),
            time: None,
            kind: None,
            status: None,
            notes: None,
            chief_complaint: None,
            physician_id: None,
            duration_minutes: None,
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("update");

    appointment_repo::delete(&pool, &t.id)
        .await
        .expect("delete");

    assert_eq!(outbox_count(&pool, "appointment").await, 3);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn app_kv_set_excludes_internal_sync_keys_but_records_practice_settings() {

/// F147: chart_validation has a composite key; writes must not fail when
/// replication is on, and each row gets its own sync id.
#[tokio::test]
async fn chart_validation_rows_record_with_composite_key() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    enable_serverless(&pool).await;
    let p = patient_repo::create(&pool, &sample_patient("cv"))
        .await
        .expect("create patient");
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::clinical::chart_validation as cv;
    cv::upsert_row(&pool, &p.id, "anamnesis", "2026-11-07T10:00:00Z", None)
        .await
        .expect("upsert a");
    cv::upsert_row(&pool, &p.id, "findings", "2026-11-07T10:00:00Z", None)
        .await
        .expect("upsert b");
    let ids: Vec<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT entity_id FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity_table = 'chart_validation' ORDER BY entity_id",
    )
    .fetch_all(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        ids,
        vec![format!("{}|anamnesis", p.id), format!("{}|findings", p.id)]
    );
    let payload: String = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT payload_json FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity_table = 'chart_validation' LIMIT 1",
    )
    .fetch_one(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert!(payload.contains("section_or_item"));
}

//! H2/H3: table registry, deny-list, tombstones.

use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::recorded_write::{record_in_tx, row_json};
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::{synced_tables, TABLES};

#[tokio::test]
async fn registry_lists_every_table_exactly_once() {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    let names: Vec<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_sqlx_%'",
    )
    .fetch_all(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("tables");
    let mut registry: Vec<&str> = TABLES.iter().map(|(n, _)| *n).collect();
    registry.sort();
    let mut unique = registry.clone();
    unique.dedup();
    assert_eq!(registry, unique, "TABLES has duplicates");
    let mut missing = Vec::new();
    for name in &names {
        if name == "audit_log_archive" {
            continue;
        }
        if !TABLES.iter().any(|(n, _)| *n == name) {
            missing.push(name.clone());
        }
    }
    assert!(
        missing.is_empty(),
        "tables missing from registry: {missing:?}"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn snapshot_and_payload_skip_denied_columns() {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    medoc_core::mvp_security::drop_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
        .await
        .ok();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role, totp_secret, token_version)
         VALUES ('s1', 'Dr', 'dr@t.de', 'hash', 'PHYSICIAN', 'SECRET', 3)",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("staff");
    let mut tx = pool.begin().await.expect("tx");
    // staff is DeviceLocal — row_json is None
    assert!(row_json(&mut tx, "staff", "s1")
        .await
        .expect("json")
        .is_none());
    sqlx::query("INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status) VALUES ('p1', 'A', '1990-01-01', 'MALE', 'INS-1', 'ACTIVE')")
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .ok();
    tx.commit().await.ok();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn delete_writes_a_tombstone() {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO app_kv (key, value) VALUES ('sync.deployment.v1',
         '{\"schemaVersion\":1,\"mode\":\"serverless_peer\",\"role\":\"REPLICA\",\"deviceLabel\":\"T\"}')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("kv");
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status)
         VALUES ('p-del', 'X', '1990-01-01', 'MALE', 'INS-DEL', 'NEW')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("patient");
    let mut tx = pool.begin().await.expect("tx");
    sqlx::query("DELETE FROM patient WHERE id = 'p-del'")
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .expect("delete");
    record_in_tx(&mut tx, "patient", "p-del", "DELETE")
        .await
        .expect("record");
    tx.commit().await.expect("commit");
    let n: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_tombstone WHERE entity_table = 'patient' AND entity_id = 'p-del'",
    )
    .fetch_one(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("count");
    assert_eq!(n, 1);
    assert!(synced_tables().any(|t| t == "patient"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn update_sets_updated_at() {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    let mut missing = Vec::new();
    for table in synced_tables() {
        let exists: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = ?1",
        )
        .bind(table)
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("exists");
        if exists == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let n: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(&format!(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('{table}') WHERE name = 'updated_at'"
        ))
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("pragma");
        if n == 0 {
            missing.push(table);
        }
    }
    assert!(missing.is_empty(), "missing updated_at on {missing:?}");

    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status)
         VALUES ('seed-patient-001', 'Seed Patient', '1980-01-01', 'FEMALE', 'SEED-INS-001', 'ACTIVE')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("seed patient");
    sqlx::query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO patient_chart (id, patient_id) VALUES ('seed-chart-001', 'seed-patient-001')")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("seed chart");
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO examination (id, chart_id, chief_complaint, updated_at)
         VALUES ('exam-ts-1', 'seed-chart-001', 'before', '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z')",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("exam row");
    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20)).await;
    sqlx::query(
        "UPDATE examination SET chief_complaint = 'stamp', updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
         WHERE id = 'exam-ts-1'",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("update exam");
    let after: String =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT updated_at FROM examination WHERE id = 'exam-ts-1'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("after");
    assert!(!after.is_empty());
    assert_ne!(after, "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
}

//! Password login while two-factor is off. Enrollment gates live in `totp_tests.rs`
//! and stay ignored until `TOTP_2FA_ENABLED` is turned back on.

use medoc_core::application::auth_service::{authenticate, LoginRequest};
use medoc_core::infrastructure::crypto;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::device_session as device_session_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::staff as staff_repo;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::totp;

async fn pool() -> sqlx::SqlitePool {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    medoc_core::mvp_security::drop_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("quota");
    pool
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn enrolled_physician_signs_in_without_a_code() {
    let pool = pool().await;
    let hash = crypto::hash_password("TestPass42").expect("hash");
    let (secret, _) = totp::generate_enrollment("physician@practice.test").expect("enroll");
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role, totp_secret, totp_enrolled_at)
         VALUES ('doc-1', 'Dr', 'physician@practice.test', ?1, 'PHYSICIAN', ?2, datetime('now'))",
    )
    .bind(&hash)
    .bind(&secret)
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("insert");

    let session = authenticate(
        &pool,
        &LoginRequest {
            email: "physician@practice.test".into(),
            password: "TestPass42".into(),
            totp_code: None,
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("password login while 2FA is off");
    assert_eq!(session.role, "PHYSICIAN");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn password_change_bumps_the_token_and_ends_other_sessions() {
    let pool = pool().await;
    let hash = crypto::hash_password("TestPass42").expect("hash");
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role)
         VALUES ('doc-1', 'Dr', 'physician@practice.test', ?1, 'PHYSICIAN')",
    )
    .bind(&hash)
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("insert");
    device_session_repo::insert(&pool, "keep", "doc-1", "This desk", None, None)
        .await
        .expect("keep");
    device_session_repo::insert(&pool, "other", "doc-1", "Other desk", None, None)
        .await
        .expect("other");

    let next = crypto::hash_password("BetterPass42").expect("hash");
    staff_repo::replace_password(&pool, "doc-1", &next)
        .await
        .expect("password");
    device_session_repo::end_other_than(&pool, "doc-1", "keep")
        .await
        .expect("end");

    assert_eq!(
        staff_repo::token_version(&pool, "doc-1")
            .await
            .expect("version"),
        1
    );
    let ended: Option<String> =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT ended_at FROM device_session WHERE id = 'other'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("other row");
    let kept: Option<String> =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT ended_at FROM device_session WHERE id = 'keep'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("keep row");
    assert!(ended.is_some());
    assert!(kept.is_none());
}
